17: /**
18:  * The CustomerService class is an application service that is
19:  * responsible for creating, updating and retrieving customer entities.
20:  * */
21: @Component
22: public class CustomerService implements ApplicationService {
23: 	@Autowired
24: 	private CustomerRepository customerRepository;
25: 	@Autowired
26: 	private CustomerFactory customerFactory;
27: 	public Optional<CustomerAggregateRoot> updateAddress(CustomerId customerId, Address updatedAddress) {
28: 		Optional<CustomerAggregateRoot> optCustomer = customerRepository.findById(customerId);
29: 		if (!optCustomer.isPresent()) {
30: 			return optCustomer;
31: 		}
32: 		CustomerAggregateRoot customer = optCustomer.get();
33: 		customer.moveToAddress(updatedAddress);
34: 		customerRepository.save(customer);
35: 		return optCustomer;
36: 	}
37: 	public Optional<CustomerAggregateRoot> updateCustomerProfile(CustomerId customerId, CustomerProfileEntity updatedCustomerProfile) {
38: 		Optional<CustomerAggregateRoot> optCustomer = customerRepository.findById(customerId);
39: 		if (!optCustomer.isPresent()) {
40: 			return optCustomer;
41: 		}
42: 		CustomerAggregateRoot customer = optCustomer.get();
43: 		customer.updateCustomerProfile(updatedCustomerProfile);
44: 		customerRepository.save(customer);
45: 		return optCustomer;
46: 	}
47: 	public CustomerAggregateRoot createCustomer(CustomerProfileEntity customerProfile) {
48: 		CustomerAggregateRoot customer = customerFactory.create(customerProfile);
49: 		customerRepository.save(customer);
50: 		return customer;
51: 	}
52: 	public List<CustomerAggregateRoot> getCustomers(String ids) {
53: 		List<CustomerId> customerIds = Arrays.asList(ids.split(",")).stream().map(id -> new CustomerId(id.trim())).collect(Collectors.toList());
54: 		List<CustomerAggregateRoot> customers = new ArrayList<>();
55: 		for (CustomerId customerId : customerIds) {
56: 			Optional<CustomerAggregateRoot> customer = customerRepository.findById(customerId);
57: 			if (customer.isPresent()) {
58: 				customers.add(customer.get());
59: 			}
60: 		}
61: 		return customers;
62: 	}
63: 	public Page<CustomerAggregateRoot> getCustomers(String filter, int limit, int offset) {
64: 		final List<CustomerAggregateRoot> filteredCustomers = customerRepository
65: 				.findAll(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "customerProfile.firstname", "customerProfile.lastname")).stream()
66: 				.filter(customer -> matchesFilter(customer, filter))
67: 				.collect(Collectors.toList());
68: 		final int size = filteredCustomers.size();
69: 		final List<CustomerAggregateRoot> customers = filteredCustomers.stream().skip(offset).limit(limit).collect(Collectors.toList());
70: 		return new Page<>(customers, offset, limit, size);
71: 	}
72: 	private boolean matchesFilter(CustomerAggregateRoot customer, String filter) {
73: 		final String[] searchTerms = filter.toLowerCase().split(" ");
74: 		final String firstname = customer.getCustomerProfile().getFirstname().toLowerCase();
75: 		final String lastname = customer.getCustomerProfile().getLastname().toLowerCase();
76: 		for (String searchTerm : searchTerms) {
77: 			if (!searchTerm.isEmpty() && !firstname.contains(searchTerm) && !lastname.contains(searchTerm)) {
78: 				return false;
79: 			}
80: 		}
81: 		return true;
82: 	}
83: }

26: /**
27:  * The run() method of the DataLoader class is automatically executed when the application launches.
28:  * It populates the database with sample customers that can be used to test the application.
29:  * */
30: @Component
31: @Profile("!test")
32: public class DataLoader implements ApplicationRunner {
33: 	@Autowired
34: 	private CustomerRepository customerRepository;
35: 	private Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
36: 	private List<CustomerAggregateRoot> createCustomersFromDummyData(List<Map<String, String>> customerData) {
37: 		SimpleDateFormat birthdayFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("MM/dd/yyyy");
38: 		List<CustomerAggregateRoot> customers = customerData.stream().map(data -> {
39: 			final CustomerId customerId = new CustomerId(data.get("id"));
40: 			final String firstName = data.get("first_name");
41: 			final String lastName = data.get("last_name");
42: 			Date birthday = null;
43: 			try {
44: 				birthday = birthdayFormat.parse(data.get("birthday"));
45: 			} catch (ParseException e) {
46: 			}
47: 			final Address currentAddress = new Address(data.get("street_address"), data.get("postal_code"), data.get("city"));
48: 			final String email = data.get("email");
49: 			final String phoneNumber = data.get("phone_number");
50: 			final CustomerProfileEntity customerProfile = new CustomerProfileEntity(firstName, lastName, birthday, currentAddress, email, phoneNumber);
51: 			return new CustomerAggregateRoot(customerId, customerProfile);
52: 		}).collect(Collectors.toList());
53: 		return customers;
54: 	}
55: 	/**
56: 	 * Note: The files mock_customers_small.csv and mock_customers_large.csv are the same as the files
57: 	 * mock_users_small.csv and mock_users_large.csv in the Customer Self-Service backend. The Customer
58: 	 * Core DataLoader creates a customer for each row in the corresponding CSV file and the
59: 	 * Customer Self-Service DataLoader creates a user login for each of these customers. Therefore,
60: 	 * these files should be kept in sync.
61: 	 *
62: 	 * This dummy data was generated using https://mockaroo.com/
63: 	 */
64: 	private List<Map<String, String>> loadCustomers() {
65: 		try(InputStream file = new ClassPathResource("mock_customers_small.csv").getInputStream()) {
66: 			CsvMapper mapper = new CsvMapper();
67: 			CsvSchema schema = CsvSchema.emptySchema().withHeader();
68: 			MappingIterator<Map<String, String>> readValues = mapper.readerFor(Map.class).with(schema).readValues(file);
69: 			return readValues.readAll();
70: 		} catch (Exception e) {
71: 			return Collections.emptyList();
72: 		}
73: 	}
74: 	@Override
75: 	public void run(ApplicationArguments args) throws ParseException {
76: 		if(customerRepository.count() > 0) {
77: 			logger.info("Skipping import of application dummy data, because the database already contains existing entities.");
78: 			return;
79: 		}
80: 		List<Map<String, String>> customerData = loadCustomers();
81: 		logger.info("Loaded " + customerData.size() + " customers.");
82: 		List<CustomerAggregateRoot> customers = createCustomersFromDummyData(customerData);
83: 		logger.info("Created " + customerData.size() + " customers.");
84: 		customerRepository.saveAll(customers);
85: 		logger.info("Inserted " + customerData.size() + " customers into database.");
86: 		logger.info("DataLoader has successfully imported all application dummy data, the application is now ready.");
87: 	}
88: }

 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customercore.domain.city;
 2: import java.io.IOException;
 3: import java.io.InputStream;
 4: import java.util.ArrayList;
 5: import java.util.List;
 6: import java.util.Map;
 7: import org.microserviceapipatterns.domaindrivendesign.DomainService;
 8: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 9: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
10: import org.springframework.core.io.ClassPathResource;
11: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
12: import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.MappingIterator;
13: import com.fasterxml.jackson.dataformat.csv.CsvMapper;
14: import com.fasterxml.jackson.dataformat.csv.CsvSchema;
15: import com.google.common.collect.Multimap;
16: import com.google.common.collect.TreeMultimap;
17: /**
18:  * This is a DDD Domain Service and is automatically injected thanks
19:  * to the @Component annotation. Note that we could also have used the @Service
20:  * annotation, which is an alias for @Component.
21:  */
22: @Component
23: public class CityLookupService implements DomainService {
24: 	private final static String CSV_FILE = "cities_by_postalcode_switzerland.csv";
25: 	private final static char CSV_SEPARATOR = ';';
26: 	private final static String POSTAL_CODE_KEY = "postalCode";
27: 	private final static String CITY_KEY = "city";
28: 	private static Multimap<String, String> lookupMap = null;
29: 	private final static Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CityLookupService.class);
30: 	private static Multimap<String, String> loadLookupMap() {
31: 		Multimap<String, String> map = TreeMultimap.create();
32: 		try(InputStream file = new ClassPathResource(CSV_FILE).getInputStream()) {
33: 			CsvMapper mapper = new CsvMapper();
34: 			CsvSchema schema = CsvSchema.emptySchema().withHeader().withColumnSeparator(CSV_SEPARATOR);
35: 			MappingIterator<Map<String, String>> readValues = mapper.readerFor(Map.class).with(schema).readValues(file);
36: 			List<Map<String, String>> values = readValues.readAll();
37: 			for (Map<String, String> value : values) {
38: 				String postalCode = value.get(POSTAL_CODE_KEY).trim();
39: 				String city = value.get(CITY_KEY).trim();
40: 				if (city == null || postalCode == null) {
41: 					continue;
42: 				}
43: 				map.put(postalCode, city);
44: 			}
45: 		} catch (IOException e) {
46: 			logger.error("Failed to create city lookup-map.", e);
47: 		}
48: 		return map;
49: 	}
50: 	private static Multimap<String, String> getLookupMap() {
51: 		if (lookupMap == null) {
52: 			lookupMap = loadLookupMap();
53: 			logger.info("Loaded " + lookupMap.size() + " postal-code / city pairs.");
54: 		}
55: 		return lookupMap;
56: 	}
57: 	/**
58: 	 * Returns an alphabetically ordered list of cities that match the given postal
59: 	 * code.
60: 	 */
61: 	public List<String> getCitiesForPostalCode(String postalCode) {
62: 		Multimap<String, String> lookupMap = getLookupMap();
63: 		return new ArrayList<>(lookupMap.get(postalCode));
64: 	}
65: }

12:  * This discrepancy exists for technical reasons. JPA requires Address to be declared as an entity, because it is part of a one-to-many
13:  * relationship. However, in the DDD sense, Address behaves like a Value Object (i.e., it has no id and is immutable).
14:  * */

46: 	}
47: 	@Override

49: 		if (this == obj) {
50: 			return true;

54: 		}

56: 			return false;
57: 		}

60: 				Objects.equals(postalCode, other.postalCode) &&
61: 				Objects.equals(city, other.city);
62: 	}
63: 	@Override

 7: import io.github.adr.embedded.MADR;
 8: /**
 9:  * CustomerAggregateRoot is the root entity of the Customer aggregate. Note that there is
10:  * no class for the Customer aggregate, so the package can be seen as aggregate.

27: 	}
28: 	public CustomerId getId() {
29: 		return id;
30: 	}
31: 	@MADR(
32: 			value = 1,
33: 			title = "Data transfer between interface layer and domain layer",
34: 			contextAndProblem = "Need to pass information from the interfaces layer to the domain layer without introducing a layering violation",
35: 			alternatives = {
36: 					"Pass existing domain objects",
37: 					"Pass the DTOs directly",
38: 					"Pass the components of the DTO",
39: 					"Add a new value type in the domain layer and use it as parameter object"
40: 			},
41: 			chosenAlternative = "Pass existing domain objects",
42: 			justification = "This solution doesn't introduce a layering violation and it is simple because it doesn't require any additional classes."
43: 			)
44: 	public void moveToAddress(Address address) {
45: 		customerProfile.moveToAddress(address);
46: 	}

 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customercore.domain.customer;

 3: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
 4: import com.google.i18n.phonenumbers.NumberParseException;
 5: import com.google.i18n.phonenumbers.PhoneNumberUtil;
 6: import com.google.i18n.phonenumbers.PhoneNumberUtil.PhoneNumberFormat;
 7: import com.google.i18n.phonenumbers.Phonenumber.PhoneNumber;
 8: import com.lakesidemutual.customercore.infrastructure.CustomerRepository;
 9: import org.microserviceapipatterns.domaindrivendesign.Factory;
10: /**
11:  * CustomerFactory is a factory that is responsible for the creation of CustomerAggregateRoot objects.
12:  * It makes sure that each new customer has a unique CustomerId and that phone numbers are formatted
13:  * correctly.
14:  * */
15: @Component
16: public class CustomerFactory implements Factory {
17: 	@Autowired
18: 	private CustomerRepository customerRepository;
19: 	public CustomerAggregateRoot create(CustomerProfileEntity customerProfile) {
20: 		CustomerId id = customerRepository.nextId();
21: 		customerProfile.setPhoneNumber(formatPhoneNumber(customerProfile.getPhoneNumber()));
22: 		return new CustomerAggregateRoot(id, customerProfile);
23: 	}
24: 	public static String formatPhoneNumber(String phoneNumberStr) {
25: 		PhoneNumberUtil phoneUtil = PhoneNumberUtil.getInstance();
26: 		try {
27: 			PhoneNumber phoneNumber = phoneUtil.parse(phoneNumberStr, "CH");
28: 			return phoneUtil.format(phoneNumber, PhoneNumberFormat.NATIONAL);
29: 		} catch (NumberParseException e) {
30: 			throw new AssertionError();
31: 		}
32: 	}
33: }

File: customer-core/src/main/java/com/lakesidemutual/customercore/interfaces/configuration/APIKeyAuthenticationManager.java
================
 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customercore.interfaces.configuration;
 2: import java.util.List;
 3: import org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationManager;
 4: import org.springframework.security.authentication.BadCredentialsException;
 5: import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
 6: import org.springframework.security.core.AuthenticationException;
 7: /**
 8:  * The APIKeyAuthenticationManager ensures that only known clients can access the Customer Core API. It is an example of the <a href=
 9:  * "https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/qualityManagementAndGovernance/APIKey">API Key</a> pattern
10:  * where each client identifies itself with an API Key. Example:
11:  * <br/>
12:  *
13:  * <br/>
14:  * <b>Missing API Key</b>
15:  * <pre>
16:  *   <code>
17:  * $ curl localhost:8110/customers
18:  * {
19:  *  "timestamp" : "2018-11-12T15:39:14.959+0000",
20:  *  "status" : 403,
21:  *  "error" : "Forbidden",
22:  *  "message" : "Access Denied",
23:  *  "path" : "/customers"
24:  * }
25:  *   </code>
26:  * </pre>
27:  *
28:  * <b>Valid API Key</b>
29:  * <pre>
30:  *   <code>
31:  * $ curl -H "Authorization: Bearer b318ad736c6c844b" localhost:8110/customers
32:  * {
33:  *  "filter" : "",
34:  *  "limit" : 10,
35:  *  "offset" : 0,
36:  *  "size" : 50,
37:  *  "customers" : [
38:  *  	...
39:  *  ]
40:  * }
41:  *   </code>
42:  * </pre>
43:  *
44:  * @see <a href=
45:  *      "https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/qualityManagementAndGovernance/APIKey">https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/qualityManagementAndGovernance/APIKey</a>
46:  */
47: public class APIKeyAuthenticationManager implements AuthenticationManager {
48: 	private final List<String> validAPIKeys;
49: 	public APIKeyAuthenticationManager(List<String> validAPIKeys) {
50: 		this.validAPIKeys = validAPIKeys;
51: 	}
52: 	@Override
53: 	public Authentication authenticate(Authentication authentication) throws AuthenticationException {
54: 		final String bearerPrefix = "Bearer ";
55: 		final String principal = (String)authentication.getPrincipal();
56: 		if(!principal.startsWith(bearerPrefix)) {
57: 			throw new BadCredentialsException("Invalid API Key");
58: 		}
59: 		final String apiKey = principal.substring(bearerPrefix.length());
60: 		if(!validAPIKeys.contains(apiKey)) {
61: 			throw new BadCredentialsException("Invalid API Key");
62: 		}
63: 		authentication.setAuthenticated(true);
64: 		return authentication;
65: 	}
66: }

12:  * The WebSecurityConfiguration class configures the security policies used for the exposed HTTP resource API.
13:  * In this case, it ensures that only clients with a valid API key can access the API.
14:  */
15: @Configuration
16: @EnableWebSecurity
17: @EnableGlobalMethodSecurity(prePostEnabled = true)
18: public class WebSecurityConfiguration extends WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter {
19: 	private static final String[] AUTH_WHITELIST = {
20: 			// -- swagger ui
21: 			"/swagger-resources/**",
22: 			"/swagger-ui/**",
23: 			"/v2/api-docs",
24: 			"/webjars/**",
25: 			// spring-boot-starter-actuator health checks and other info
26: 			"/actuator/**",
27: 			"/actuator",
28: 			// H2 Console
29: 			"/console/**",
30: 			// Spring Web Services
31: 			"/ws/**",
32: 			"/ws",
33: 			// Thymeleaf demo FE
34: 			"/customercorefe",
35: 	};
36: 	@Value("${apikey.header}")
37: 	private String apiKeyHeader;
38: 	@Value("${apikey.validkeys}")
39: 	private String apiKeyValidKeys;
40: 	@Override
41: 	protected void configure(HttpSecurity httpSecurity) throws Exception {
42: 		final List<String> validAPIKeys = Arrays.asList(apiKeyValidKeys.split(";"));
43: 		final APIKeyAuthFilter filter = new APIKeyAuthFilter(apiKeyHeader);
44: 		filter.setAuthenticationManager(new APIKeyAuthenticationManager(validAPIKeys));
45: 		httpSecurity.headers().frameOptions().disable().and().csrf().disable().exceptionHandling()
46: 		.and().sessionManagement().sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS).and()
47: 		.addFilter(filter).authorizeRequests().antMatchers(AUTH_WHITELIST).permitAll().anyRequest().authenticated();
48: 		// Disable Cache-Control for Conditional Requests
49: 		httpSecurity.headers().cacheControl().disable();
50: 	}
51: }

 40: /**
 41:  * This REST controller gives clients access to the customer data. It is an example of the
 42:  * <i>Information Holder Resource</i> pattern. This particular one is a special type of information holder called <i>Master Data Holder</i>.
 43:  *
 44:  * @see <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/responsibility/endpointRoles/InformationHolderResource">Information Holder Resource</a>
 45:  * @see <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/responsibility/informationHolderEndpointTypes/MasterDataHolder">Master Data Holder</a>
 46:  *
 47:  * Note: JAX-WS and JAX-RS (or Spring Web Services and REST annotations) support could be added to the same controller/port class (in port-and-adapter or hexagon style terms, by A. Cockburn). 
 48:  * But such hybrid approach gets messy soon (due to "annotation jungle"). Hence, there is a separate CustomerInformationHolderSOAPAdapter.
 49:  *
 50:  */
 51: @RestController
 52: @RequestMapping("/customers")
 53: public class CustomerInformationHolder {
 54: 	private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
 55: 	/**
 56: 	 * Attributes marked with @Autowired are automatically created and injected by
 57: 	 * Spring.
 58: 	 */
 59: 	@Autowired
 60: 	private CustomerService customerService;
 61: 	private Set<String> getIncludedFields(String fields) {
 62: 		if (fields.trim().isEmpty()) {
 63: 			return Collections.emptySet();
 64: 		} else {
 65: 			return new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(fields.split(",")));
 66: 		}
 67: 	}
 68: 	private CustomerResponseDto createCustomerResponseDto(CustomerAggregateRoot customer, String fields) {
 69: 		final Set<String> includedFields = getIncludedFields(fields);
 70: 		CustomerResponseDto customerResponseDto = new CustomerResponseDto(includedFields, customer);
 71: 		Link selfLink = linkTo(
 72: 				methodOn(CustomerInformationHolder.class).getCustomer(customer.getId().toString(), fields))
 73: 				.withSelfRel();
 74: 		Link updateAddressLink = linkTo(methodOn(CustomerInformationHolder.class).changeAddress(customer.getId(), null))
 75: 				.withRel("address.change");
 76: 		customerResponseDto.add(selfLink);
 77: 		customerResponseDto.add(updateAddressLink);
 78: 		return customerResponseDto;
 79: 	}
 80: 	private PaginatedCustomerResponseDto createPaginatedCustomerResponseDto(String filter, Integer limit,
 81: 			Integer offset, int size, String fields, List<CustomerResponseDto> customerDtos) {
 82: 		PaginatedCustomerResponseDto paginatedCustomerResponseDto = new PaginatedCustomerResponseDto(filter, limit,
 83: 				offset, size, customerDtos);
 84: 		paginatedCustomerResponseDto
 85: 		.add(linkTo(methodOn(CustomerInformationHolder.class).getCustomers(filter, limit, offset, fields))
 86: 				.withSelfRel());
 87: 		if (offset > 0) {
 88: 			paginatedCustomerResponseDto.add(linkTo(methodOn(CustomerInformationHolder.class).getCustomers(filter,
 89: 					limit, Math.max(0, offset - limit), fields)).withRel("prev"));
 90: 		}
 91: 		if (offset < size - limit) {
 92: 			paginatedCustomerResponseDto.add(linkTo(
 93: 					methodOn(CustomerInformationHolder.class).getCustomers(filter, limit, offset + limit, fields))
 94: 					.withRel("next"));
 95: 		}
 96: 		return paginatedCustomerResponseDto;
 97: 	}
 98: 	/**
 99: 	 * Returns a 'page' of customers. <br>
100: 	 * <br>
101: 	 * The query parameters {@code limit} and {@code offset} can be used to specify
102: 	 * the maximum size of the page and the offset of the page's first customer.
103: 	 * Example Usage:
104: 	 *
105: 	 * <pre>
106: 	 * <code>
107: 	 * GET http://localhost:8110/customers?limit=2&offset=2
108: 	 *
109: 	 * {
110: 	 *   "limit" : 2,
111: 	 *   "offset" : 2,
112: 	 *   "size" : 50,
113: 	 *   "customers" : [ {
114: 	 *     "customerId" : "ctkdzorjl0",
115: 	 *     "firstname" : "Rahel",
116: 	 *     "lastname" : "Piletic",
117: 	 *     ...
118: 	 *  }, {
119: 	 *     "customerId" : "5xvivyzxvc",
120: 	 *     "firstname" : "Cullin",
121: 	 *     "lastname" : "Manske",
122: 	 *     ...
123: 	 *  } ],
124: 	 *   "_links" : {
125: 	 *     "self" : {
126: 	 *       "href" : "http://localhost:8110/customers?limit=2&offset=2&fields="
127: 	 *     },
128: 	 *     "prev" : {
129: 	 *       "href" : "http://localhost:8110/customers?limit=2&offset=0&fields="
130: 	 *     },
131: 	 *     "next" : {
132: 	 *       "href" : "http://localhost:8110/customers?limit=2&offset=4&fields="
133: 	 *     }
134: 	 *   }
135: 	 * }
136: 	 * </code>
137: 	 * </pre>
138: 	 *
139: 	 * The response contains the customers, limit and offset of the current page as
140: 	 * well as the total number of customers (size). Additionally, it contains
141: 	 * HATEOAS-style links that link to the endpoint address of the current,
142: 	 * previous and next page.
143: 	 *
144: 	 * @see <a href=
145: 	 *      "https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/structure/compositeRepresentations/Pagination">https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/structure/compositeRepresentations/Pagination</a>
146: 	 */
147: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Get all customers in pages of 10 entries per page.")
148: 	@GetMapping // MAP operation responsibility: Retrieval Operation
149: 	public ResponseEntity<PaginatedCustomerResponseDto> getCustomers(
150: 			@ApiParam(value = "search terms to filter the customers by name", required = false) @RequestParam(value = "filter", required = false, defaultValue = "") String filter,
151: 			@ApiParam(value = "the maximum number of customers per page", required = false) @RequestParam(value = "limit", required = false, defaultValue = "10") Integer limit,
152: 			@ApiParam(value = "the offset of the page's first customer", required = false) @RequestParam(value = "offset", required = false, defaultValue = "0") Integer offset,
153: 			@ApiParam(value = "a comma-separated list of the fields that should be included in the response", required = false) @RequestParam(value = "fields", required = false, defaultValue = "") String fields) {
154: 		final String decodedFilter = UriUtils.decode(filter, "UTF-8");
155: 		final Page<CustomerAggregateRoot> customerPage = customerService.getCustomers(decodedFilter, limit, offset);
156: 		List<CustomerResponseDto> customerDtos = customerPage.getElements().stream().map(c -> createCustomerResponseDto(c, fields)).collect(Collectors.toList());
157: 		PaginatedCustomerResponseDto paginatedCustomerResponseDto = createPaginatedCustomerResponseDto(
158: 				filter,
159: 				customerPage.getLimit(),
160: 				customerPage.getOffset(),
161: 				customerPage.getSize(),
162: 				fields,
163: 				customerDtos);
164: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(paginatedCustomerResponseDto);
165: 	}
166: 	/**
167: 	 * Returns the customers for the given customer ids. <br>
168: 	 * <br>
169: 	 * The client can provide a comma-separated list of customer ids to fetch a
170: 	 * particular set of customers. This is a variant of the <a href=
171: 	 * "https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/dataTransferParsimony/RequestBundle">Request
172: 	 * Bundle</a> pattern:
173: 	 *
174: 	 * <pre>
175: 	 *   <code>
176: 	 * GET http://localhost:8110/customers/ce4btlyluu,rgpp0wkpec
177: 	 *
178: 	 * {
179: 	 *   "customers" : [
180: 	 *     {
181: 	 *       "customerId" : "ce4btlyluu",
182: 	 *       "firstname" : "Robbie",
183: 	 *       "lastname" : "Davenhall",
184: 	 *       "birthday" : "1961-08-11T23:00:00.000+0000",
185: 	 *       ...
186: 	 *       "_links" : { ... }
187: 	 *     },
188: 	 *     {
189: 	 *       "customerId" : "rgpp0wkpec",
190: 	 *       "firstname" : "Max",
191: 	 *       "lastname" : "Mustermann",
192: 	 *       "birthday" : "1989-12-31T23:00:00.000+0000",
193: 	 *       ...
194: 	 *       "_links" : { ... }
195: 	 *     }
196: 	 *   ],
197: 	 *   "_links" : {
198: 	 *     "self" : {
199: 	 *       "href" : "http://localhost:8110/customers/ce4btlyluu,rgpp0wkpec?fields="
200: 	 *     }
201: 	 *   }
202: 	 * }
203: 	 *   </code>
204: 	 * </pre>
205: 	 *
206: 	 * By default getCustomer() returns a response that includes all fields. The
207: 	 * client can also reduce the size of the response by providing a so-called
208: 	 * <a href=
209: 	 * "https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/dataTransferParsimony/WishList">Wish
210: 	 * List</a> with the query parameter {@code fields}:
211: 	 *
212: 	 * <pre>
213: 	 *   <code>
214: 	 * GET http://localhost:8110/customers/ce4btlyluu,rgpp0wkpec?fields=firstname,lastname
215: 	 *
216: 	 * {
217: 	 *   "customers" : [
218: 	 *     {
219: 	 *       "firstname" : "Robbie",
220: 	 *       "lastname" : "Davenhall",
221: 	 *       "_links" : { ... }
222: 	 *     },
223: 	 *     {
224: 	 *       "firstname" : "Max",
225: 	 *       "lastname" : "Mustermann",
226: 	 *       "_links" : { ... }
227: 	 *     }
228: 	 *   ],
229: 	 *   "_links" : {
230: 	 *     "self" : {
231: 	 *       "href" : "http://localhost:8110/customers/ce4btlyluu,rgpp0wkpec?fields="
232: 	 *     }
233: 	 *   }
234: 	 * }
235: 	 *   </code>
236: 	 * </pre>
237: 	 *
238: 	 * @see <a href=
239: 	 *      "https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/dataTransferParsimony/RequestBundle">https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/dataTransferParsimony/RequestBundle</a>
240: 	 * @see <a href=
241: 	 *      "https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/dataTransferParsimony/WishList">https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/dataTransferParsimony/WishList</a>
242: 	 */
243: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Get a specific set of customers.")
244: 	@GetMapping(value = "/{ids}") // MAP operation responsibility: Retrieval Operation
245: 	public ResponseEntity<CustomersResponseDto> getCustomer(
246: 			@ApiParam(value = "a comma-separated list of customer ids", required = true) @PathVariable String ids,
247: 			@ApiParam(value = "a comma-separated list of the fields that should be included in the response", required = false) @RequestParam(value = "fields", required = false, defaultValue = "") String fields) {
248: 		List<CustomerAggregateRoot> customers = customerService.getCustomers(ids);
249: 		List<CustomerResponseDto> customerResponseDtos = customers.stream()
250: 				.map(customer -> createCustomerResponseDto(customer, fields)).collect(Collectors.toList());
251: 		CustomersResponseDto customersResponseDto = new CustomersResponseDto(customerResponseDtos);
252: 		Link selfLink = linkTo(methodOn(CustomerInformationHolder.class).getCustomer(ids, fields)).withSelfRel();
253: 		customersResponseDto.add(selfLink);
254: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(customersResponseDto);
255: 	}
256: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Update the profile of the customer with the given customer id")
257: 	@PutMapping(value = "/{customerId}") // MAP operation responsibility: State Transition Operation (Full Replace)
258: 	public ResponseEntity<CustomerResponseDto> updateCustomer(
259: 			@ApiParam(value = "the customer's unique id", required = true) @PathVariable CustomerId customerId,
260: 			@ApiParam(value = "the customer's updated profile", required = true) @Valid @RequestBody CustomerProfileUpdateRequestDto requestDto) {
261: 		final CustomerProfileEntity updatedCustomerProfile = requestDto.toDomainObject();
262: 		Optional<CustomerAggregateRoot> optCustomer = customerService.updateCustomerProfile(customerId, updatedCustomerProfile);
263: 		if(!optCustomer.isPresent()) {
264: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to find a customer with id '" + customerId.toString() + "'.";
265: 			logger.info(errorMessage);
266: 			throw new CustomerNotFoundException(errorMessage);
267: 		}
268: 		CustomerAggregateRoot customer = optCustomer.get();
269: 		CustomerResponseDto response = new CustomerResponseDto(Collections.emptySet(), customer);
270: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
271: 	}
272: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Change a customer's address.")
273: 	@PutMapping(value = "/{customerId}/address") // MAP operation responsibility: State Transition Operation (Partial Update)
274: 	public ResponseEntity<AddressDto> changeAddress(
275: 			@ApiParam(value = "the customer's unique id", required = true) @PathVariable CustomerId customerId,
276: 			@ApiParam(value = "the customer's new address", required = true) @Valid @RequestBody AddressDto requestDto) {
277: 		Address updatedAddress = requestDto.toDomainObject();
278: 		Optional<CustomerAggregateRoot> optCustomer = customerService.updateAddress(customerId, updatedAddress);
279: 		if (!optCustomer.isPresent()) {
280: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to find a customer with id '" + customerId.toString() + "'.";
281: 			logger.info(errorMessage);
282: 			throw new CustomerNotFoundException(errorMessage);
283: 		}
284: 		AddressDto responseDto = AddressDto.fromDomainObject(updatedAddress);
285: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(responseDto);
286: 	}
287: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Create a new customer.")
288: 	@PostMapping // MAP operation responsibility: State Creation Operation
289: 	public ResponseEntity<CustomerResponseDto> createCustomer(
290: 			@ApiParam(value = "the customer's profile information", required = true) @Valid @RequestBody CustomerProfileUpdateRequestDto requestDto) {
291: 		CustomerProfileEntity customerProfile = requestDto.toDomainObject();
292: 		CustomerAggregateRoot customer = customerService.createCustomer(customerProfile);
293: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(createCustomerResponseDto(customer, ""));
294: 	}
295: }

 35: /**
 36:  * Based on: https://spring.io/guides/gs/producing-web-service/ and https://spring.io/guides/gs/consuming-web-service/
 37:  * TODO note that when testing with Postman or curl, Content Type header must be set to "text/xml" (maps to SOAP 1.1)!
 38:  *
 39:  * This WS controller gives clients access to the customer data. It is an example of the
 40:  * <i>Information Holder Resource</i> pattern. This particular one is a special type of information holder called <i>Master Data Holder</i>.
 41:  *
 42:  * @see <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/responsibility/endpointRoles/InformationHolderResource">Information Holder Resource</a>
 43:  * @see <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/responsibility/informationHolderEndpointTypes/MasterDataHolder">Master Data Holder</a>
 44:  */
 45: @Endpoint

 47: 	private static final String NAMESPACE_URI = "http://lm.com/ccore";
 48: 	private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
 49: 	/**
 50: 	 * Attributes marked with @Autowired are automatically created and injected by
 51: 	 * Spring.
 52: 	 */
 53: 	@Autowired
 54: 	private CustomerService customerService;
 55: 	private Set<String> getIncludedFields(String fields) {
 56: 		if (fields.trim().isEmpty()) {
 57: 			return Collections.emptySet();
 58: 		} else {
 59: 			return new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(fields.split(",")));
 60: 		}
 61: 	}
 62: 	private CustomerResponseDto createCustomerResponseDto(CustomerAggregateRoot customer, String fields) {
 63: 		final Set<String> includedFields = getIncludedFields(fields);

 70: 				.withRel("address.change");
 71: 		customerResponseDto.add(selfLink);
 72: 		customerResponseDto.add(updateAddressLink);
 73: 		 */
 74: 		return customerResponseDto;
 75: 	}
 76: 	private PaginatedCustomerResponseDto createPaginatedCustomerResponseDto(String filter, Integer limit,
 77: 			Integer offset, int size, String fields, List<CustomerResponseDto> customerDtos) {
 78: 		PaginatedCustomerResponseDto paginatedCustomerResponseDto = new PaginatedCustomerResponseDto(filter, limit,
 79: 				offset, size, customerDtos);
 80: 		/*

 85: 			paginatedCustomerResponseDto.add(linkTo(methodOn(CustomerInformationHolderWebServiceAdapter.class).getCustomers(filter,
 86: 					limit, Math.max(0, offset - limit), fields)).withRel("prev"));
 87: 		}
 88: 		if (offset < size - limit) {
 89: 			paginatedCustomerResponseDto.add(linkTo(

 91: 					.withRel("next"));
 92: 		}
 93: 		 */
 94: 		return paginatedCustomerResponseDto;
 95: 	}
 96: 	// TODO not exposed via SOAP/HTTP yet
 97: 	// MAP operation responsibility: Retrieval Operation
 98: 	public PaginatedCustomerResponseDto getCustomers(
 99: 			String filter,
100: 			Integer limit,
101: 			Integer offset,
102: 			String fields) {
103: 		final Page<CustomerAggregateRoot> customerPage = customerService.getCustomers(filter, limit, offset);
104: 		List<CustomerResponseDto> customerDtos = customerPage.getElements().stream().map(c -> createCustomerResponseDto(c, fields)).collect(Collectors.toList());
105: 		PaginatedCustomerResponseDto paginatedCustomerResponseDto = createPaginatedCustomerResponseDto(

109: 				customerPage.getSize(),
110: 				fields,
111: 				customerDtos);
112: 		return paginatedCustomerResponseDto;
113: 	}

146: 	// TODO not exposed via SOAP/HTTP yet
147: 	// MAP operation responsibility: State Transition Operation (Full Replace)
148: 	public CustomerResponseDto updateCustomer(
149: 			CustomerId customerId,
150: 			@Valid CustomerProfileUpdateRequestDto requestDto) {
151: 		final CustomerProfileEntity updatedCustomerProfile = requestDto.toDomainObject();
152: 		Optional<CustomerAggregateRoot> optCustomer = customerService.updateCustomerProfile(customerId, updatedCustomerProfile);
153: 		if(!optCustomer.isPresent()) {
154: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to find a customer with id '" + customerId.toString() + "'.";
155: 			logger.info(errorMessage);
156: 			throw new CustomerNotFoundException(errorMessage);
157: 		}
158: 		CustomerAggregateRoot customer = optCustomer.get();
159: 		CustomerResponseDto response = new CustomerResponseDto(Collections.emptySet(), customer);
160: 		return response;
161: 	}
162: 	// TODO not exposed via SOAP/HTTP yet
163: 	// MAP operation responsibility: State Transition Operation (Partial Update)
164: 	public AddressDto changeAddress(
165: 			CustomerId customerId,
166: 			@Valid AddressDto requestDto) {
167: 		Address updatedAddress = requestDto.toDomainObject();
168: 		Optional<CustomerAggregateRoot> optCustomer = customerService.updateAddress(customerId, updatedAddress);
169: 		if (!optCustomer.isPresent()) {
170: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to find a customer with id '" + customerId.toString() + "'.";
171: 			logger.info(errorMessage);
172: 			throw new CustomerNotFoundException(errorMessage);
173: 		}
174: 		return AddressDto.fromDomainObject(updatedAddress);
175: 	}
176: 	// TODO not exposed via SOAP/HTTP yet
177: 	// MAP operation responsibility: State Creation Operation
178: 	public CustomerResponseDto createCustomer(
179: 			@Valid CustomerProfileUpdateRequestDto requestDto) {
180: 		CustomerProfileEntity customerProfile = requestDto.toDomainObject();
181: 		CustomerAggregateRoot customer = customerService.createCustomer(customerProfile);
182: 		return createCustomerResponseDto(customer, "");
183: 	}

 3: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
 4: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 5: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

12: /**
13:  * This class implements a custom error controller that returns an <a href=
14:  * "https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/qualityManagementAndGovernance/ErrorReport">Error
15:  * Report</a>.
16:  */
17: @Controller
18: public class ErrorController extends AbstractErrorController {
19: 	private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
20: 	public ErrorController(ErrorAttributes errorAttributes) {
21: 		super(errorAttributes);
22: 	}
23: 	@RequestMapping(value = "/error", produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
24: 	@ResponseBody
25: 	public Map<String, Object> handleError(HttpServletRequest request) {
26: 		Map<String, Object> errorAttributes = super.getErrorAttributes(request, true);
27: 		Object path = errorAttributes.get("path");
28: 		Object status = errorAttributes.get("status");
29: 		Object error = errorAttributes.get("error");
30: 		Object message = errorAttributes.get("message");
31: 		logger.info("An error occurred while accessing {}: {} {}, {}", path, status, error, message);
32: 		return errorAttributes;

 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customercore.interfaces.validation;
 2: import javax.validation.ConstraintValidator;
 3: import javax.validation.ConstraintValidatorContext;
 4: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 5: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 6: import com.google.i18n.phonenumbers.NumberParseException;
 7: import com.google.i18n.phonenumbers.PhoneNumberUtil;
 8: import com.google.i18n.phonenumbers.Phonenumber;
 9: /**
10:  * This class validates phone numbers using Google's libphonenumber (see https://github.com/googlei18n/libphonenumber).
11:  * */
12: public class PhoneNumberValidator implements ConstraintValidator<PhoneNumber, String> {
13: 	private Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
14: 	@Override
15: 	public boolean isValid(String phoneNumberStr, ConstraintValidatorContext context) {
16: 		PhoneNumberUtil phoneUtil = PhoneNumberUtil.getInstance();
17: 		try {
18: 			Phonenumber.PhoneNumber phoneNumber = phoneUtil.parse(phoneNumberStr, "CH");
19: 			return phoneUtil.isValidNumber(phoneNumber);
20: 		} catch (NumberParseException e) {
21: 			logger.info("'" + phoneNumberStr + "' is not a valid phone number.", e);
22: 			return false;
23: 		}
24: 	}
25: }

 8: COPY --from=build /usr/src/app/target/dependency/BOOT-INF/lib/* /app/lib/

10: COPY --from=build /usr/src/app/target/dependency/BOOT-INF/classes /app
11: 
12: EXPOSE 8100
13: ENTRYPOINT ["java","-cp","app:app/lib/*","com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.CustomerManagementApplication"]

File: customer-management-backend/src/main/java/com/lakesidemutual/customermanagement/domain/interactionlog/InteractionLogAggregateRoot.java
================
 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.domain.interactionlog;
 2: import java.util.Collection;
 3: import java.util.List;
 4: import java.util.stream.Collectors;
 5: import javax.persistence.CascadeType;
 6: import javax.persistence.Entity;
 7: import javax.persistence.FetchType;
 8: import javax.persistence.Id;
 9: import javax.persistence.OneToMany;
10: import javax.persistence.Table;
11: import org.microserviceapipatterns.domaindrivendesign.RootEntity;
12: /**
13:  * InteractionLogAggregateRoot is the root entity of the InteractionLog aggregate. Note that there is
14:  * no class for the InteractionLog aggregate, so the package can be seen as aggregate.
15:  */
16: @Entity
17: @Table(name = "interactionlogs")
18: public class InteractionLogAggregateRoot implements RootEntity {
19: 	@Id
20: 	private String customerId;
21: 	private String username;
22: 	private String lastAcknowledgedInteractionId;
23: 	@OneToMany(fetch = FetchType.EAGER, cascade = CascadeType.ALL)
24: 	private final Collection<InteractionEntity> interactions;
25: 	public InteractionLogAggregateRoot() {
26: 		this.customerId = null;
27: 		this.username = null;
28: 		this.lastAcknowledgedInteractionId = null;
29: 		this.interactions = null;
30: 	}
31: 	public InteractionLogAggregateRoot(String customerId, String username, String lastAcknowledgedInteractionId, Collection<InteractionEntity> interactions) {
32: 		this.customerId = customerId;
33: 		this.username = username;
34: 		this.lastAcknowledgedInteractionId = lastAcknowledgedInteractionId;
35: 		this.interactions = interactions;
36: 	}
37: 	public String getCustomerId() {
38: 		return customerId;
39: 	}
40: 	public String getUsername() {
41: 		return username;
42: 	}
43: 	public String getLastAcknowledgedInteractionId() {
44: 		return lastAcknowledgedInteractionId;
45: 	}
46: 	public void setLastAcknowledgedInteractionId(String lastAcknowledgedInteractionId) {
47: 		this.lastAcknowledgedInteractionId = lastAcknowledgedInteractionId;
48: 	}
49: 	public Collection<InteractionEntity> getInteractions() {
50: 		return interactions;
51: 	}
52: 	public int getNumberOfUnacknowledgedInteractions() {
53: 		final List<InteractionEntity> interactions = getInteractions().stream().filter(interaction -> !interaction.isSentByOperator()).collect(Collectors.toList());
54: 		if(lastAcknowledgedInteractionId == null) {
55: 			return interactions.size();
56: 		} else {
57: 			int count = 0;
58: 			for(int i = interactions.size()-1; i >= 0; i--) {
59: 				if(lastAcknowledgedInteractionId.equals(interactions.get(i).getId())) {
60: 					break;
61: 				} else {
62: 					count += 1;
63: 				}
64: 			}
65: 			return count;
66: 		}
67: 	}
68: }

File: customer-management-backend/src/main/java/com/lakesidemutual/customermanagement/domain/interactionlog/InteractionLogService.java
================
 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.domain.interactionlog;
 2: import java.util.ArrayList;
 3: import java.util.List;
 4: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
 5: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
 6: import com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.infrastructure.InteractionLogRepository;
 7: import org.microserviceapipatterns.domaindrivendesign.DomainService;
 8: /**
 9:  * InteractionLogService is a domain service which generates notification objects for any unacknowledged interactions.
10:  */
11: @Component
12: public class InteractionLogService implements DomainService {
13: 	@Autowired
14: 	private InteractionLogRepository interactionLogRepository;
15: 	public List<Notification> getNotifications() {
16: 		final List<Notification> notifications = new ArrayList<>();
17: 		final List<InteractionLogAggregateRoot> interactionLogs = interactionLogRepository.findAll();
18: 		for(InteractionLogAggregateRoot interactionLog : interactionLogs) {
19: 			int count = interactionLog.getNumberOfUnacknowledgedInteractions();
20: 			if(count > 0) {
21: 				Notification notification = new Notification(interactionLog.getCustomerId(), interactionLog.getUsername(), count);
22: 				notifications.add(notification);
23: 			}
24: 		}
25: 		return notifications;
26: 	}
27: }

 7:  * The APIKeyRequestInterceptor class sets the API Key for outgoing requests to the customer-core service.

 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.infrastructure;

 3: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 4: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

15: /**
16:  * CustomerCoreRemoteProxy is a remote proxy that interacts with the Customer
17:  * Core in order to give the Customer Management Backend's own clients access to
18:  * the shared customer data.
19:  */
20: @Component
21: public class CustomerCoreRemoteProxy implements InfrastructureService {
22: 	private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
23: 	@Autowired
24: 	private CustomerCoreClient customerCoreClient;
25: 	public CustomerDto getCustomer(CustomerId customerId) {
26: 		try {
27: 			CustomersDto customersDto = customerCoreClient.getCustomer(customerId.getId());
28: 			return customersDto.getCustomers().isEmpty() ? null : customersDto.getCustomers().get(0);
29: 		} catch(FeignException e) {
30: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to connect to Customer Core.";
31: 			logger.info(errorMessage, e);
32: 			throw new CustomerCoreNotAvailableException(errorMessage);
33: 		}
34: 	}
35: 	public PaginatedCustomerResponseDto getCustomers(String filter, int limit, int offset) {
36: 		try {
37: 			return customerCoreClient.getCustomers(filter, limit, offset);
38: 		} catch(FeignException e) {
39: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to connect to Customer Core.";
40: 			logger.info(errorMessage, e);
41: 			throw new CustomerCoreNotAvailableException(errorMessage);
42: 		}
43: 	}
44: 	public ResponseEntity<CustomerDto> updateCustomer(CustomerId customerId, CustomerProfileDto customerProfile) {
45: 		try {
46: 			return customerCoreClient.updateCustomer(customerId, customerProfile);
47: 		} catch(FeignException e) {
48: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to connect to Customer Core.";
49: 			logger.info(errorMessage, e);
50: 			throw new CustomerCoreNotAvailableException(errorMessage);
51: 		}
52: 	}
53: }

 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.interfaces.configuration;
 2: import java.io.IOException;
 3: import java.util.Collections;
 4: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
 5: import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
 6: import org.springframework.http.HttpRequest;
 7: import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
 8: import org.springframework.http.client.ClientHttpRequestExecution;
 9: import org.springframework.http.client.ClientHttpRequestInterceptor;
10: import org.springframework.http.client.ClientHttpResponse;
11: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
12: @Component
13: public class HeaderRequestInterceptor implements ClientHttpRequestInterceptor {
14: 	@Value("${apikey.header}")
15: 	private String apiKeyHeader;
16: 	@Value("${apikey.value}")
17: 	private String apiKeyValue;
18: 	@Override
19: 	public ClientHttpResponse intercept(HttpRequest request, byte[] body, ClientHttpRequestExecution execution)
20: 			throws IOException {
21: 		final HttpHeaders httpHeaders = request.getHeaders();
22: 		httpHeaders.set(apiKeyHeader, "Bearer " + apiKeyValue);
23: 		httpHeaders.setAccept(Collections.singletonList(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON));
24: 		return execution.execute(request, body);
25: 	}
26: }

13: /**
14:  * The WebSecurityConfiguration class configures the security policies used for the exposed HTTP resource API.
15:  * In this case, the API is accessible without authentication.
16:  */

38: 		source.registerCorsConfiguration("/interaction-logs/*", configuration);

26:  * @see <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/responsibility/endpointRoles/InformationHolderResource">Information Holder Resource</a>

File: customer-management-backend/src/main/java/com/lakesidemutual/customermanagement/interfaces/CustomerMessageController.java
================
 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.interfaces;
 2: import java.util.ArrayList;
 3: import java.util.Collection;
 4: import java.util.Date;
 5: import java.util.List;
 6: import java.util.Optional;
 7: import java.util.UUID;
 8: import java.util.stream.Collectors;
 9: import org.slf4j.Logger;
10: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
11: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
12: import org.springframework.messaging.handler.annotation.MessageMapping;
13: import org.springframework.messaging.handler.annotation.SendTo;
14: import org.springframework.messaging.simp.SimpMessagingTemplate;
15: import org.springframework.stereotype.Controller;
16: import com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.domain.interactionlog.InteractionEntity;
17: import com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.domain.interactionlog.InteractionLogAggregateRoot;
18: import com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.domain.interactionlog.InteractionLogService;
19: import com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.infrastructure.InteractionLogRepository;
20: import com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.interfaces.dtos.MessageDto;
21: import com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.interfaces.dtos.NotificationDto;
22: /**
23:  * This class is a Controller that processes WebSocket chat messages and broadcasts them to all subscribers.
24:  * */
25: @Controller
26: public class CustomerMessageController {
27: 	private final static Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CustomerMessageController.class);
28: 	@Autowired
29: 	private InteractionLogRepository interactionLogRepository;
30: 	@Autowired
31: 	private InteractionLogService interactionLogService;
32: 	@Autowired
33: 	private SimpMessagingTemplate simpMessagingTemplate;
34: 	@MessageMapping("/chat/messages")
35: 	@SendTo("/topic/messages")
36: 	public MessageDto processMessage(MessageDto message) throws Exception {
37: 		logger.info("Processing message from " + message.getUsername());
38: 		final String customerId = message.getCustomerId();
39: 		final String id = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
40: 		final Date date = new Date();
41: 		final InteractionEntity interaction = new InteractionEntity(id, date, message.getContent(), message.isSentByOperator());
42: 		final Optional<InteractionLogAggregateRoot> optInteractionLog = interactionLogRepository.findById(customerId);
43: 		InteractionLogAggregateRoot interactionLog;
44: 		if (optInteractionLog.isPresent()) {
45: 			interactionLog = optInteractionLog.get();
46: 			interactionLog.getInteractions().add(interaction);
47: 		} else {
48: 			Collection<InteractionEntity> interactions = new ArrayList<>();
49: 			interactions.add(interaction);
50: 			interactionLog = new InteractionLogAggregateRoot(customerId, message.getUsername(), null, interactions);
51: 		}
52: 		interactionLogRepository.save(interactionLog);
53: 		broadcastNotifications();
54: 		return new MessageDto(id, date, message.getCustomerId(), message.getUsername(), message.getContent(), message.isSentByOperator());
55: 	}
56: 	private void broadcastNotifications() {
57: 		logger.info("Broadcasting updated notifications");
58: 		final List<NotificationDto> notifications = interactionLogService.getNotifications().stream()
59: 				.map(notification -> new NotificationDto(notification.getCustomerId(), notification.getUsername(), notification.getCount()))
60: 				.collect(Collectors.toList());
61: 		simpMessagingTemplate.convertAndSend("/topic/notifications", notifications);
62: 	}
63: }

 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.interfaces;
 2: import java.util.Map;
 3: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
 4: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 5: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 6: import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.web.servlet.error.AbstractErrorController;
 7: import org.springframework.boot.web.servlet.error.ErrorAttributes;
 8: import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
 9: import org.springframework.stereotype.Controller;
10: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
11: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ResponseBody;
12: /**
13:  * This class implements a custom error controller that returns an <a href=
14:  * "https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/qualityManagementAndGovernance/ErrorReport">Error
15:  * Report</a>.
16:  */
17: @Controller
18: public class ErrorController extends AbstractErrorController {
19: 	private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
20: 	public ErrorController(ErrorAttributes errorAttributes) {
21: 		super(errorAttributes);
22: 	}
23: 	@RequestMapping(value = "/error", produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
24: 	@ResponseBody
25: 	public Map<String, Object> handleError(HttpServletRequest request) {
26: 		Map<String, Object> errorAttributes = super.getErrorAttributes(request, true);
27: 		Object path = errorAttributes.get("path");
28: 		Object status = errorAttributes.get("status");
29: 		Object error = errorAttributes.get("error");
30: 		Object message = errorAttributes.get("message");
31: 		logger.info("An error occurred while accessing {}: {} {}, {}", path, status, error, message);
32: 		return errorAttributes;
33: 	}
34: 	@Override
35: 	public String getErrorPath() {
36: 		return "/error";
37: 	}
38: }

File: customer-management-backend/src/main/java/com/lakesidemutual/customermanagement/interfaces/InteractionLogInformationHolder.java
================
 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.interfaces;
 2: import java.util.ArrayList;
 3: import java.util.List;
 4: import java.util.Optional;
 5: import java.util.stream.Collectors;
 6: import javax.validation.Valid;
 7: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 8: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 9: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
10: import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
11: import org.springframework.messaging.simp.SimpMessagingTemplate;
12: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
13: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PatchMapping;
14: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
15: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
16: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
17: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
18: import com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.domain.customer.CustomerId;
19: import com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.domain.interactionlog.InteractionLogAggregateRoot;
20: import com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.domain.interactionlog.InteractionLogService;
21: import com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.infrastructure.InteractionLogRepository;
22: import com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.interfaces.dtos.InteractionAcknowledgementDto;
23: import com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.interfaces.dtos.InteractionLogNotFoundException;
24: import com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.interfaces.dtos.NotificationDto;
25: import io.swagger.annotations.ApiOperation;
26: import io.swagger.annotations.ApiParam;
27: /**
28:  * This REST controller gives clients access to a customer's interaction log. It is an example of the
29:  * <i>Information Holder Resource</i> pattern. This particular one is a special type of information holder called <i>Master Data Holder</i>.
30:  *
31:  * @see <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/responsibility/endpointRoles/InformationHolderResource">Information Holder Resource</a>
32:  * @see <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/responsibility/informationHolderEndpointTypes/MasterDataHolder">Master Data Holder</a>
33:  */
34: @RestController
35: @RequestMapping("/interaction-logs")
36: public class InteractionLogInformationHolder {
37: 	private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
38: 	@Autowired
39: 	private InteractionLogService interactionLogService;
40: 	@Autowired
41: 	private InteractionLogRepository interactionLogRepository;
42: 	@Autowired
43: 	private SimpMessagingTemplate simpMessagingTemplate;
44: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Get the interaction log for a customer with a given customer id.")
45: 	@GetMapping(value = "/{customerId}")
46: 	public ResponseEntity<InteractionLogAggregateRoot> getInteractionLog(
47: 			@ApiParam(value = "the customer's unique id", required = true) @PathVariable CustomerId customerId) {
48: 		final String customerIdStr = customerId.getId();
49: 		Optional<InteractionLogAggregateRoot> optInteractionLog = interactionLogRepository.findById(customerIdStr);
50: 		if (!optInteractionLog.isPresent()) {
51: 			logger.info("Failed to find an interaction log for the customer with id '" + customerId.toString() + "'. Returning an empty interaction log instead.");
52: 			final InteractionLogAggregateRoot emptyInteractionLog = new InteractionLogAggregateRoot(customerIdStr, "", null, new ArrayList<>());
53: 			return ResponseEntity.ok(emptyInteractionLog);
54: 		}
55: 		final InteractionLogAggregateRoot interactionLog = optInteractionLog.get();
56: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(interactionLog);
57: 	}
58: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Acknowledge all of a given customer's interactions up to the given interaction id.")
59: 	@PatchMapping(value = "/{customerId}")
60: 	public ResponseEntity<InteractionLogAggregateRoot> acknowledgeInteractions(
61: 			@ApiParam(value = "the customer's unique id", required = true) @PathVariable CustomerId customerId,
62: 			@ApiParam(value = "the id of the newest acknowledged interaction", required = true) @Valid @RequestBody InteractionAcknowledgementDto interactionAcknowledgementDto) {
63: 		final String customerIdStr = customerId.getId();
64: 		Optional<InteractionLogAggregateRoot> optInteractionLog = interactionLogRepository.findById(customerIdStr);
65: 		if (!optInteractionLog.isPresent()) {
66: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to acknowledge interactions, because there is no interaction log for customer with id '" + customerId.getId() + "'.";
67: 			logger.info(errorMessage);
68: 			throw new InteractionLogNotFoundException(errorMessage);
69: 		}
70: 		final InteractionLogAggregateRoot interactionLog = optInteractionLog.get();
71: 		interactionLog.setLastAcknowledgedInteractionId(interactionAcknowledgementDto.getLastAcknowledgedInteractionId());
72: 		interactionLogRepository.save(interactionLog);
73: 		broadcastNotifications();
74: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(interactionLog);
75: 	}
76: 	private void broadcastNotifications() {
77: 		logger.info("Broadcasting updated notifications");
78: 		final List<NotificationDto> notifications = interactionLogService.getNotifications().stream()
79: 				.map(notification -> new NotificationDto(notification.getCustomerId(), notification.getUsername(), notification.getCount()))
80: 				.collect(Collectors.toList());
81: 		simpMessagingTemplate.convertAndSend("/topic/notifications", notifications);
82: 	}
83: }

 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.interfaces;
 2: import java.util.List;
 3: import java.util.stream.Collectors;
 4: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
 5: import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
 6: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
 7: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
 8: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
 9: import com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.domain.interactionlog.InteractionLogService;
10: import com.lakesidemutual.customermanagement.interfaces.dtos.NotificationDto;
11: import io.swagger.annotations.ApiOperation;
12: /**
13:  * This REST controller gives clients access the current list of unacknowledged chat notifications. It is an example of the
14:  * <i>Information Holder Resource</i> pattern. This particular one is a special type of information holder called <i>Master Data Holder</i>.
15:  *
16:  * @see <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/responsibility/endpointRoles/InformationHolderResource">Information Holder Resource</a>

File: customer-self-service-backend/src/main/java/com/lakesidemutual/customerselfservice/application/DataLoader.java
================
 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.application;
 2: import java.io.InputStream;
 3: import java.text.ParseException;
 4: import java.util.Collections;
 5: import java.util.List;
 6: import java.util.Map;
 7: import java.util.stream.Collectors;
 8: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 9: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
10: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
11: import org.springframework.boot.ApplicationArguments;
12: import org.springframework.boot.ApplicationRunner;
13: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Profile;
14: import org.springframework.core.io.ClassPathResource;
15: import org.springframework.security.crypto.bcrypt.BCryptPasswordEncoder;
16: import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;
17: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
18: import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.MappingIterator;
19: import com.fasterxml.jackson.dataformat.csv.CsvMapper;
20: import com.fasterxml.jackson.dataformat.csv.CsvSchema;
21: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.domain.customer.CustomerId;
22: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.domain.identityaccess.UserLoginEntity;
23: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.infrastructure.UserLoginRepository;
24: /**
25:  * The run() method of the DataLoader class is automatically executed when the application launches.
26:  * It populates the database with sample user logins that can be used to test the application.
27:  * */
28: @Component
29: @Profile("!test")
30: public class DataLoader implements ApplicationRunner {
31: 	@Autowired
32: 	private UserLoginRepository userRepository;
33: 	private Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
34: 	private List<UserLoginEntity> createUserLoginsFromDummyData(List<Map<String, String>> userData) {
35: 		PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder = new BCryptPasswordEncoder();
36: 		return userData.stream().map(data -> {
37: 			final String email = data.get("email");
38: 			final String hashedPassword = passwordEncoder.encode(data.get("password"));
39: 			final CustomerId customerId = new CustomerId(data.get("id"));
40: 			return new UserLoginEntity(email, hashedPassword, "USER", customerId);
41: 		}).collect(Collectors.toList());
42: 	}
43: 	/**
44: 	 * Note: The files mock_users_small.csv and mock_users_large.csv are the same as the files
45: 	 * mock_customers_small.csv and mock_customers_large.csv in the Customer Core. The Customer
46: 	 * Core DataLoader creates a customer for each row in the corresponding CSV file and the
47: 	 * Customer Self-Service DataLoader creates a user login for each of these customers. Therefore,
48: 	 * these files should be kept in sync.
49: 	 *
50: 	 * This dummy data was generated using https://mockaroo.com/
51: 	 */
52: 	private List<Map<String, String>> loadUsers() {
53: 		try(InputStream file = new ClassPathResource("mock_users_small.csv").getInputStream()) {
54: 			CsvMapper mapper = new CsvMapper();
55: 			CsvSchema schema = CsvSchema.emptySchema().withHeader();
56: 			MappingIterator<Map<String, String>> readValues = mapper.readerFor(Map.class).with(schema).readValues(file);
57: 			return readValues.readAll();
58: 		} catch (Exception e) {
59: 			return Collections.emptyList();
60: 		}
61: 	}
62: 	@Override
63: 	public void run(ApplicationArguments args) throws ParseException {
64: 		if(userRepository.count() > 0) {
65: 			logger.info("Skipping import of application dummy data, because the database already contains existing entities.");
66: 			return;
67: 		}
68: 		List<Map<String, String>> userData = loadUsers();
69: 		logger.info("Loaded " + userData.size() + " users.");
70: 		List<UserLoginEntity> userLogins = createUserLoginsFromDummyData(userData);
71: 		logger.info("Created " + userLogins.size() + " user logins.");
72: 		userRepository.saveAll(userLogins);
73: 		logger.info("Inserted " + userLogins.size() + " user logins into database.");
74: 		logger.info("DataLoader has successfully imported all application dummy data, the application is now ready.");
75: 	}
76: }

File: customer-self-service-backend/src/main/java/com/lakesidemutual/customerselfservice/domain/customer/Address.java
================
 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.domain.customer;
 2: import java.util.Objects;
 3: import javax.persistence.Entity;
 4: import javax.persistence.GeneratedValue;
 5: import javax.persistence.Id;
 6: import javax.persistence.Table;
 7: import org.microserviceapipatterns.domaindrivendesign.ValueObject;
 8: /**
 9:  * An Address is a value object that is used to represent the postal address of a customer.
10:  *
11:  * You might be wondering why the Address class implements the ValueObject interface even though it has a JPA @Entity annotation.
12:  * This discrepancy exists for technical reasons. JPA requires Address to be declared as an entity, because it is part of a one-to-many
13:  * relationship. However, in the DDD sense, Address behaves like a value object.
14:  *
15:  * You also might be wondering why this code is the same as that in the Customer Core. This does violate DRY but for
16:  * good reasons: strategic DD suggests that model boundaries decouple (sub-)systems so that they can be deployed and
17:  * evolved independently.
18:  * */
19: @Entity
20: @Table(name = "addresses")
21: public class Address implements ValueObject {
22: 	@GeneratedValue
23: 	@Id
24: 	private Long id;
25: 	private final String streetAddress;
26: 	private final String postalCode;
27: 	private final String city;
28: 	public Address() {
29: 		this.streetAddress = null;
30: 		this.postalCode = null;
31: 		this.city = null;
32: 	}
33: 	public Address(String streetAddress, String postalCode, String city) {
34: 		this.streetAddress = streetAddress;
35: 		this.postalCode = postalCode;
36: 		this.city = city;
37: 	}
38: 	public String getStreetAddress() {
39: 		return streetAddress;
40: 	}
41: 	public String getPostalCode() {
42: 		return postalCode;
43: 	}
44: 	public String getCity() {
45: 		return city;
46: 	}
47: 	@Override
48: 	public String toString() {
49: 		return String.format("%s, %s %ss", streetAddress, postalCode, city);
50: 	}
51: 	@Override
52: 	public boolean equals(Object obj) {
53: 		if (this == obj) {
54: 			return true;
55: 		}
56: 		if (obj == null) {
57: 			return false;
58: 		}
59: 		if (getClass() != obj.getClass()) {
60: 			return false;
61: 		}
62: 		Address other = (Address) obj;
63: 		return Objects.equals(streetAddress, other.streetAddress) &&
64: 				Objects.equals(postalCode, other.postalCode) &&
65: 				Objects.equals(city, other.city);
66: 	}
67: 	@Override
68: 	public int hashCode() {
69: 		return Objects.hash(streetAddress, postalCode, city);
70: 	}
71: }

41: 		return Objects.equals(getId(), other.getId());
42: 	}

 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.domain.identityaccess;
 2: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
 3: import org.springframework.security.core.authority.AuthorityUtils;
 4: import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails;
 5: import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService;
 6: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
 7: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.infrastructure.UserLoginRepository;
 8: import org.microserviceapipatterns.domaindrivendesign.DomainService;
 9: /**
10:  * UserDetailsServiceImpl is a domain service that can load user logins from the UserLoginRepository.
11:  * */

13: public class UserDetailsServiceImpl implements UserDetailsService, DomainService {
14: 	@Autowired
15: 	private UserLoginRepository userRepository;
16: 	@Override
17: 	public UserDetails loadUserByUsername(String email) {
18: 		UserLoginEntity user = this.userRepository.findByEmail(email);
19: 		if (user == null) {
20: 			return null;
21: 		} else {
22: 			return new UserSecurityDetails(
23: 					user.getId(),
24: 					user.getEmail(),
25: 					user.getPassword(),
26: 					AuthorityUtils.commaSeparatedStringToAuthorityList(user.getAuthorities())
27: 					);
28: 		}
29: 	}
30: }

 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.domain.insurancequoterequest;
 2: import java.util.ArrayList;
 3: import java.util.Date;
 4: import java.util.List;
 5: import javax.persistence.CascadeType;
 6: import javax.persistence.Entity;
 7: import javax.persistence.FetchType;
 8: import javax.persistence.GeneratedValue;
 9: import javax.persistence.Id;
10: import javax.persistence.OneToMany;
11: import javax.persistence.OneToOne;
12: import javax.persistence.Table;
13: import org.microserviceapipatterns.domaindrivendesign.RootEntity;
14: /**
15:  * InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot is the root entity of the Insurance Quote Request aggregate. Note that there is
16:  * no class for the Insurance Quote Request aggregate, so the package can be seen as aggregate.
17:  */
18: @Entity
19: @Table(name = "insurancequoterequests")
20: public class InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot implements RootEntity {
21: 	@Id
22: 	@GeneratedValue
23: 	private Long id;
24: 	private Date date;
25: 	@OneToMany(fetch = FetchType.EAGER, cascade = CascadeType.ALL)
26: 	private List<RequestStatusChange> statusHistory;
27: 	@OneToOne(cascade = CascadeType.ALL)
28: 	private CustomerInfoEntity customerInfo;
29: 	@OneToOne(cascade = CascadeType.ALL)
30: 	private InsuranceOptionsEntity insuranceOptions;
31: 	@OneToOne(cascade = CascadeType.ALL)
32: 	private InsuranceQuoteEntity insuranceQuote;
33: 	private String policyId;
34: 	public InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot() {}
35: 	public InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot(Date date, RequestStatus initialStatus, CustomerInfoEntity customerInfo, InsuranceOptionsEntity insuranceOptions, InsuranceQuoteEntity insuranceQuote, String policyId) {
36: 		this.date = date;
37: 		List<RequestStatusChange> statusHistory = new ArrayList<>();
38: 		statusHistory.add(new RequestStatusChange(date, initialStatus));
39: 		this.statusHistory = statusHistory;
40: 		this.customerInfo = customerInfo;
41: 		this.insuranceOptions = insuranceOptions;
42: 		this.insuranceQuote = insuranceQuote;
43: 		this.policyId = policyId;
44: 	}
45: 	public Long getId() {
46: 		return id;
47: 	}
48: 	public Date getDate() {
49: 		return date;
50: 	}
51: 	public RequestStatus getStatus() {
52: 		return statusHistory.get(statusHistory.size()-1).getStatus();
53: 	}
54: 	public List<RequestStatusChange> getStatusHistory() {
55: 		return statusHistory;
56: 	}
57: 	private void changeStatusTo(RequestStatus newStatus, Date date) {
58: 		if (!getStatus().canTransitionTo(newStatus)) {
59: 			throw new RuntimeException(String.format("Cannot change insurance quote request status from %s to %s", getStatus(), newStatus));
60: 		}
61: 		statusHistory.add(new RequestStatusChange(date, newStatus));
62: 	}
63: 	public void acceptRequest(InsuranceQuoteEntity insuranceQuote, Date date) {
64: 		this.insuranceQuote = insuranceQuote;
65: 		changeStatusTo(RequestStatus.QUOTE_RECEIVED, date);
66: 	}
67: 	public void rejectRequest(Date date) {
68: 		changeStatusTo(RequestStatus.REQUEST_REJECTED, date);
69: 	}
70: 	public void acceptQuote(Date date) {
71: 		changeStatusTo(RequestStatus.QUOTE_ACCEPTED, date);
72: 	}
73: 	public void rejectQuote(Date date) {
74: 		changeStatusTo(RequestStatus.QUOTE_REJECTED, date);
75: 	}
76: 	public void markQuoteAsExpired(Date date) {
77: 		changeStatusTo(RequestStatus.QUOTE_EXPIRED, date);
78: 	}
79: 	public void finalizeQuote(String policyId, Date date) {
80: 		changeStatusTo(RequestStatus.POLICY_CREATED, date);
81: 	}
82: 	public CustomerInfoEntity getCustomerInfo() {
83: 		return customerInfo;
84: 	}
85: 	public InsuranceOptionsEntity getInsuranceOptions() {
86: 		return insuranceOptions;
87: 	}
88: 	public InsuranceQuoteEntity getInsuranceQuote() {
89: 		return insuranceQuote;
90: 	}
91: 	public String getPolicyId() {
92: 		return policyId;
93: 	}
94: }

================
 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.domain.insurancequoterequest;
 2: import org.microserviceapipatterns.domaindrivendesign.ValueObject;
 3: /**
 4:  * A RequestStatus is a value object that is used to represent
 5:  * the current status of an insurance quote request.
 6:  *
 7:  * The following diagram shows the possible state transitions:
 8:  *
 9:  * <pre>
10:  *
11:  *                                               │
12:  *                                               ▼
13:  *                                        ┌────────────┐
14:  *                                        │  REQUEST_  │
15:  *                                        │ SUBMITTED  │
16:  *                                        └────────────┘
17:  *                                               │
18:  *                             ┌─────────────────┴────────────────┐
19:  *                             │                                  │
20:  *                             ▼                                  ▼
21:  *                      ┌────────────┐                     ╔════════════╗
22:  *                      │   QUOTE_   │                     ║  REQUEST_  ║
23:  *          ┌───────────│  RECEIVED  │─────────────┐       ║  REJECTED  ║
24:  *          │           └────────────┘             │       ╚════════════╝
25:  *          │                  │                   │
26:  *          │                  │                   │
27:  *          ▼                  ▼                   ▼
28:  *   ╔════════════╗     ┌────────────┐      ╔════════════╗
29:  *   ║   QUOTE_   ║     │   QUOTE_   │      ║   QUOTE_   ║
30:  *   ║  REJECTED  ║     │  ACCEPTED  │─────▶║  EXPIRED   ║
31:  *   ╚════════════╝     └────────────┘      ╚════════════╝
32:  *                             │
33:  *                             │
34:  *                             ▼
35:  *                      ╔════════════╗
36:  *                      ║  POLICY_   ║
37:  *                      ║  CREATED   ║
38:  *                      ╚════════════╝
39:  *
40:  * </pre>
41:  */
42: public enum RequestStatus implements ValueObject {
43: 	/** The customer has submitted a request. No answer has been received yet. */
44: 	REQUEST_SUBMITTED,
45: 	/** Lakeside Mutual has rejected the request. No quote has been made. */
46: 	REQUEST_REJECTED,
47: 	/** Lakeside Mutual has accepted the request and made a corresponding quote. */
48: 	QUOTE_RECEIVED,
49: 	/** The customer has accepted Lakeside Mutual's quote. */
50: 	QUOTE_ACCEPTED,
51: 	/** The customer has rejected Lakeside Mutual's quote. */
52: 	QUOTE_REJECTED,
53: 	/** The quote has expired and is no longer valid. */
54: 	QUOTE_EXPIRED,
55: 	/** A new insurance policy has been created. */
56: 	POLICY_CREATED;
57: 	public boolean canTransitionTo(RequestStatus newStatus) {
58: 		switch(this) {
59: 		case REQUEST_SUBMITTED:
60: 			return newStatus == REQUEST_REJECTED || newStatus == QUOTE_RECEIVED;
61: 		case QUOTE_RECEIVED:
62: 			return newStatus == QUOTE_ACCEPTED || newStatus == QUOTE_REJECTED || newStatus == QUOTE_EXPIRED;
63: 		case QUOTE_ACCEPTED:
64: 			return newStatus == POLICY_CREATED || newStatus == QUOTE_EXPIRED;
65: 		case REQUEST_REJECTED:
66: 		case POLICY_CREATED:
67: 		case QUOTE_REJECTED:
68: 		case QUOTE_EXPIRED:
69: 			return false;
70: 		default:
71: 			return false;
72: 		}
73: 	}
74: }

 22: import com.netflix.hystrix.contrib.javanica.annotation.HystrixCommand;
 23: /**
 24:  * CustomerCoreRemoteProxy is a remote proxy that interacts with the Customer Core in order to give
 25:  * the Customer Self-Service Backend's own clients access to the shared customer data.
 26:  * */
 27: @Component
 28: public class CustomerCoreRemoteProxy implements InfrastructureService, CustomerCoreServiceMBean {
 29: 	@Value("${customercore.baseURL}")
 30: 	private String customerCoreBaseURL;
 31: 	private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
 32: 	@Autowired
 33: 	private RestTemplate restTemplate;
 34: 	int successfulAttemptsCounter=0;
 35: 	int unsuccessfulAttemptsCounter=0;
 36: 	int fallBackMethodExecutionsCounter=0;
 37: 	// TODO test/demo that protected methods actually stops executing for defined time period,
 38: 	// otherwise the circuit breaker does not do much more than a regular exception handler
 39: 	@HystrixCommand(
 40: 			fallbackMethod = "getDummyCustomer" )
 41: 	public CustomerDto getCustomer(CustomerId customerId) {
 42: 		try {
 43: 			final String url = customerCoreBaseURL + "/customers/" + customerId.getId();
 44: 			logger.info("About to GET customer with id " + customerId);
 45: 			List<CustomerDto> customers = restTemplate.getForObject(url, CustomersDto.class).getCustomers();
 46: 			successfulAttemptsCounter++;
 47: 			return customers.isEmpty() ? null : customers.get(0);
 48: 		} catch(RestClientException e) {
 49: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to connect to Customer Core.";
 50: 			logger.info(errorMessage, e);
 51: 			unsuccessfulAttemptsCounter++;
 52: 			throw new CustomerCoreNotAvailableException(errorMessage);
 53: 		}
 54: 	}
 55: 	public CustomerDto getDummyCustomer(CustomerId customerId) {
 56: 		logger.warn("Circuit Breaker active, failed to connect to Customer Core!");
 57: 		// TODO return dummy/default customer (from local DB)?
 58: 		fallBackMethodExecutionsCounter++;
 59: 		CustomerDto customerCopy = new CustomerDto();
 60: 		customerCopy.setCustomerId(customerId.toString());
 61: 		CustomerProfileDto emptyProfile = new CustomerProfileDto();
 62: 		emptyProfile.setFirstname("WARNING: No first name info available");
 63: 		emptyProfile.setLastname("WARNING: No last name info available");
 64: 		emptyProfile.setEmail("it-support@lm.com");
 65: 		emptyProfile.setPhoneNumber("WARNING: No phone number info available");
 66: 		AddressDto currentAddress = new AddressDto();
 67: 		currentAddress.setStreetAddress("n/a");
 68: 		currentAddress.setPostalCode("n/a");
 69: 		currentAddress.setCity("n/a");
 70: 		emptyProfile.setCurrentAddress(currentAddress );
 71: 		customerCopy.setCustomerProfile(emptyProfile);
 72: 		return customerCopy;
 73: 	}
 74: 	// TODO protect other methods too?
 75: 	public ResponseEntity<AddressDto> changeAddress(CustomerId customerId, AddressDto requestDto) {
 76: 		try {
 77: 			final String url = customerCoreBaseURL + "/customers/" + customerId.getId() + "/address";
 78: 			final HttpEntity<AddressDto> requestEntity = new HttpEntity<>(requestDto);
 79: 			return restTemplate.exchange(url, HttpMethod.PUT, requestEntity, AddressDto.class);
 80: 		} catch(RestClientException e) {
 81: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to connect to Customer Core.";
 82: 			logger.info(errorMessage, e);
 83: 			throw new CustomerCoreNotAvailableException(errorMessage);
 84: 		}
 85: 	}
 86: 	public CustomerDto createCustomer(CustomerProfileUpdateRequestDto requestDto) {
 87: 		try {
 88: 			final String url = customerCoreBaseURL + "/customers";
 89: 			return restTemplate.postForObject(url, requestDto, CustomerDto.class);
 90: 		} catch(RestClientException e) {
 91: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to connect to Customer Core.";
 92: 			logger.info(errorMessage, e);
 93: 			throw new CustomerCoreNotAvailableException(errorMessage);
 94: 		}
 95: 	}
 96: 	public ResponseEntity<CitiesResponseDto> getCitiesForPostalCode(String postalCode) {
 97: 		try {
 98: 			final String url = customerCoreBaseURL + "/cities/" + postalCode;
 99: 			return restTemplate.getForEntity(url, CitiesResponseDto.class);
100: 		} catch(RestClientException e) {
101: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to connect to Customer Core.";
102: 			logger.info(errorMessage, e);
103: 			throw new CustomerCoreNotAvailableException(errorMessage);
104: 		}
105: 	}
106: 	@Override
107: 	public int getSuccessfullAttemptsCounter() {
108: 		return successfulAttemptsCounter;
109: 	}
110: 	@Override
111: 	public int getUnuccessfullAttemptsCounter() {
112: 		return unsuccessfulAttemptsCounter;
113: 	}
114: 	@Override
115: 	public int getFallbackMethodExecutionCounter() {
116: 		return fallBackMethodExecutionsCounter;
117: 	}
118: 	@Override
119: 	public void resetCounters() {
120: 		successfulAttemptsCounter=0;
121: 		unsuccessfulAttemptsCounter=0;
122: 		fallBackMethodExecutionsCounter=0;

 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.infrastructure;

 4: import org.slf4j.Logger;
