14: /**
15:  * PolicyManagementMessageProducer is an infrastructure service class that is used to notify the Policy Management Backend
16:  * when a new insurance quote request has been created (InsuranceQuoteRequestEvent) or when a customer has accepted or rejected
17:  * an insurance quote (CustomerDecisionEvent). These events are transmitted via an ActiveMQ message queue.
18:  * */
19: @Component
20: public class PolicyManagementMessageProducer implements InfrastructureService {
21: 	private Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
22: 	@Value("${insuranceQuoteRequestEvent.queueName}")
23: 	private String insuranceQuoteRequestEventQueue;
24: 	@Value("${customerDecisionEvent.queueName}")
25: 	private String customerDecisionEventQueue;
26: 	@Autowired
27: 	private JmsTemplate jmsTemplate;
28: 	public void sendInsuranceQuoteRequest(Date date, InsuranceQuoteRequestDto insuranceQuoteRequestDto) {
29: 		InsuranceQuoteRequestEvent insuranceQuoteRequestEvent = new InsuranceQuoteRequestEvent(date, insuranceQuoteRequestDto);
30: 		emitInsuranceQuoteRequestEvent(insuranceQuoteRequestEvent);
31: 	}
32: 	public void sendCustomerDecision(Date date, Long insuranceQuoteRequestId, boolean quoteAccepted) {
33: 		CustomerDecisionEvent customerDecisionEvent = new CustomerDecisionEvent(date, insuranceQuoteRequestId, quoteAccepted);
34: 		emitCustomerDecisionEvent(customerDecisionEvent);
35: 	}
36: 	private void emitInsuranceQuoteRequestEvent(InsuranceQuoteRequestEvent insuranceQuoteRequestEvent) {
37: 		try {
38: 			jmsTemplate.convertAndSend(insuranceQuoteRequestEventQueue, insuranceQuoteRequestEvent);
39: 			logger.info("Successfully sent a insurance quote request to the Policy Management backend.");
40: 		} catch(JmsException exception) {
41: 			logger.error("Failed to send a insurance quote request to the Policy Management backend.", exception);
42: 		}
43: 	}
44: 	private void emitCustomerDecisionEvent(CustomerDecisionEvent customerDecisionEvent) {
45: 		try {
46: 			jmsTemplate.convertAndSend(customerDecisionEventQueue, customerDecisionEvent);
47: 			logger.info("Successfully sent a customer decision event to the Policy Management backend.");
48: 		} catch(JmsException exception) {
49: 			logger.error("Failed to send a customer decision event to the Policy Management backend.", exception);
50: 		}
51: 	}
52: }

25: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.interfaces.dtos.identityaccess.AuthenticationResponseDto;
26: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.interfaces.dtos.identityaccess.SignupRequestDto;
27: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.interfaces.dtos.identityaccess.UserAlreadyExistsException;
28: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.interfaces.dtos.identityaccess.UserResponseDto;
29: import io.swagger.annotations.ApiOperation;
30: import io.swagger.annotations.ApiParam;
31: /**
32:  * This class is a REST Controller that is used to authenticate existing users and to sign up new users.
33:  * */
34: @RestController
35: @RequestMapping("/auth")
36: public class AuthenticationController {
37: 	private Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
38: 	@Autowired
39: 	private AuthenticationManager authenticationManager;
40: 	@Value("${token.header}")
41: 	private String tokenHeader;
42: 	@Autowired
43: 	private JwtUtils tokenUtils;
44: 	@Autowired
45: 	private UserDetailsService userDetailsService;
46: 	@Autowired
47: 	private UserLoginRepository userRepository;
48: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Authenticate a user based on a given email address and password.")
49: 	@PostMapping
50: 	public ResponseEntity<AuthenticationResponseDto> authenticationRequest(
51: 			@ApiParam(value = "the email and password used to authenticate the user", required = true) @RequestBody AuthenticationRequestDto authenticationRequest)
52: 					throws AuthenticationException {
53: 		// Perform the authentication
54: 		try {
55: 			Authentication authentication = this.authenticationManager.authenticate(new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(
56: 					authenticationRequest.getEmail(), authenticationRequest.getPassword()));
57: 			SecurityContextHolder.getContext().setAuthentication(authentication);
58: 		} catch(AuthenticationException e) {
59: 			logger.info("Authentication of user '" + authenticationRequest.getEmail() + "' failed.");
60: 			throw e;
61: 		}
62: 		// Reload password post-authentication so we can generate token
63: 		UserDetails userDetails = this.userDetailsService.loadUserByUsername(authenticationRequest.getEmail());
64: 		String token = this.tokenUtils.generateToken(userDetails);
65: 		// Return the token
66: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(new AuthenticationResponseDto(authenticationRequest.getEmail(), token));
67: 	}
68: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Create a new user.")
69: 	@PostMapping(value = "/signup")
70: 	public ResponseEntity<UserResponseDto> signupUser(
71: 			@ApiParam(value = "the email and password used to create a new user", required = true) @Valid @RequestBody SignupRequestDto registration) {
72: 		if (userRepository.findByEmail(registration.getEmail()) != null) {
73: 			final String errorMessage = "User with email '" + registration.getEmail() + "' does already exist.";
74: 			logger.info(errorMessage);
75: 			throw new UserAlreadyExistsException(errorMessage);
76: 		}
77: 		PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder = new BCryptPasswordEncoder();
78: 		String hashedPassword = passwordEncoder.encode(registration.getPassword());
79: 		UserLoginEntity newUser = new UserLoginEntity(registration.getEmail(), hashedPassword, "ADMIN", null);
80: 		userRepository.save(newUser);
81: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(new UserResponseDto(registration.getEmail(), null));
82: 	}
83: }

 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.interfaces.configuration;
 2: import java.io.IOException;
 3: import javax.servlet.FilterChain;
 4: import javax.servlet.ServletException;
 5: import javax.servlet.ServletRequest;
 6: import javax.servlet.ServletResponse;
 7: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
 8: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
 9: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
10: import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
11: import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
12: import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails;
13: import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService;
14: import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter;
15: import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.WebAuthenticationDetailsSource;
16: /**
17:  * The AuthenticationTokenFilter class ensures that only requests with a valid JWT (JSON Web Token) get through.
18:  * */
19: public class AuthenticationTokenFilter extends UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter {
20: 	@Value("${token.header}")
21: 	private String tokenHeader;
22: 	@Autowired
23: 	private JwtUtils tokenUtils;
24: 	@Autowired
25: 	private UserDetailsService userDetailsService;
26: 	@Override
27: 	public void doFilter(ServletRequest request, ServletResponse response, FilterChain chain)
28: 			throws IOException, ServletException {
29: 		HttpServletRequest httpRequest = (HttpServletRequest) request;
30: 		String authToken = httpRequest.getHeader(tokenHeader);
31: 		String username = this.tokenUtils.getUsernameFromToken(authToken);
32: 		if (username != null && SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication() == null) {
33: 			UserDetails userDetails = this.userDetailsService.loadUserByUsername(username);
34: 			if (userDetails != null && this.tokenUtils.validateToken(authToken, userDetails)) {
35: 				UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken authentication = new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(
36: 						userDetails, null, userDetails.getAuthorities());
37: 				authentication.setDetails(new WebAuthenticationDetailsSource().buildDetails(httpRequest));
38: 				SecurityContextHolder.getContext().setAuthentication(authentication);
39: 			}
40: 		}
41: 		chain.doFilter(request, response);
42: 	}
43: }

  1: package com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.interfaces.configuration;
  2: import java.util.Date;
  3: import java.util.HashMap;
  4: import java.util.Map;
  5: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
  6: import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails;
  7: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  8: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.domain.identityaccess.UserSecurityDetails;
  9: import io.jsonwebtoken.Claims;
 10: import io.jsonwebtoken.Jwts;
 11: import io.jsonwebtoken.SignatureAlgorithm;
 12: /**
 13:  * JwtUtils is a utility class that lets clients generate, validate and parse JSON Web Tokens (JWT).
 14:  * */
 15: @Component
 16: public class JwtUtils {
 17: 	@Value("${token.secret}")
 18: 	private String secret = "sssshhhh!";
 19: 	@Value("${token.expiration}")
 20: 	private int expirationInSeconds = 3600 * 24 * 7;
 21: 	public String getUsernameFromToken(String token) {
 22: 		String username;
 23: 		try {
 24: 			final Claims claims = this.getClaimsFromToken(token);
 25: 			username = claims.getSubject();
 26: 		} catch (Exception e) {
 27: 			username = null;
 28: 		}
 29: 		return username;
 30: 	}
 31: 	public Date getCreatedDateFromToken(String token) {
 32: 		Date created;
 33: 		try {
 34: 			final Claims claims = this.getClaimsFromToken(token);
 35: 			created = new Date((Long) claims.get("created"));
 36: 		} catch (Exception e) {
 37: 			created = null;
 38: 		}
 39: 		return created;
 40: 	}
 41: 	public Date getExpirationDateFromToken(String token) {
 42: 		Date expiration;
 43: 		try {
 44: 			final Claims claims = this.getClaimsFromToken(token);
 45: 			expiration = claims.getExpiration();
 46: 		} catch (Exception e) {
 47: 			expiration = null;
 48: 		}
 49: 		return expiration;
 50: 	}
 51: 	public String getAudienceFromToken(String token) {
 52: 		String audience;
 53: 		try {
 54: 			final Claims claims = this.getClaimsFromToken(token);
 55: 			audience = (String) claims.get("audience");
 56: 		} catch (Exception e) {
 57: 			audience = null;
 58: 		}
 59: 		return audience;
 60: 	}
 61: 	private Claims getClaimsFromToken(String token) {
 62: 		Claims claims;
 63: 		try {
 64: 			claims = Jwts.parser().setSigningKey(this.secret).parseClaimsJws(token).getBody();
 65: 		} catch (Exception e) {
 66: 			claims = null;
 67: 		}
 68: 		return claims;
 69: 	}
 70: 	private Date generateCurrentDate() {
 71: 		return new Date(System.currentTimeMillis());
 72: 	}
 73: 	private Date generateExpirationDate() {
 74: 		return new Date(System.currentTimeMillis() + this.expirationInSeconds * 1000);
 75: 	}
 76: 	private Boolean isTokenExpired(String token) {
 77: 		final Date expiration = this.getExpirationDateFromToken(token);
 78: 		return expiration.before(this.generateCurrentDate());
 79: 	}
 80: 	public String generateToken(UserDetails userDetails) {
 81: 		Map<String, Object> claims = new HashMap<String, Object>();
 82: 		claims.put("sub", userDetails.getUsername());
 83: 		claims.put("created", this.generateCurrentDate());
 84: 		return this.generateToken(claims);
 85: 	}
 86: 	private String generateToken(Map<String, Object> claims) {
 87: 		return Jwts.builder().setClaims(claims).setExpiration(this.generateExpirationDate())
 88: 				.signWith(SignatureAlgorithm.HS512, this.secret).compact();
 89: 	}
 90: 	public String refreshToken(String token) {
 91: 		String refreshedToken;
 92: 		try {
 93: 			final Claims claims = this.getClaimsFromToken(token);
 94: 			claims.put("created", this.generateCurrentDate());
 95: 			refreshedToken = this.generateToken(claims);
 96: 		} catch (Exception e) {
 97: 			refreshedToken = null;
 98: 		}
 99: 		return refreshedToken;
100: 	}
101: 	public Boolean validateToken(String token, UserDetails userDetails) {
102: 		UserSecurityDetails user = (UserSecurityDetails) userDetails;
103: 		final String username = this.getUsernameFromToken(token);
104: 		return username.equals(user.getUsername()) && !(this.isTokenExpired(token));
105: 	}
106: }

File: customer-self-service-backend/src/main/java/com/lakesidemutual/customerselfservice/interfaces/configuration/RateLimitInterceptor.java
================
 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.interfaces.configuration;
 2: import java.util.Collections;
 3: import java.util.Set;
 4: import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
 5: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
 6: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
 7: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 8: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 9: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
10: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
11: import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
12: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
13: import org.springframework.web.servlet.HandlerInterceptor;
14: import es.moki.ratelimitj.core.limiter.request.RequestLimitRule;
15: import es.moki.ratelimitj.core.limiter.request.RequestRateLimiter;
16: import es.moki.ratelimitj.inmemory.request.InMemorySlidingWindowRequestRateLimiter;
17: /**
18:  * RateLimitInterceptor ensures that client can't overuse the service. What
19:  * follows is a simple implementation that limits clients to 60 requests per
20:  * minute. Clients are identified by their IP address. Once the limit is
21:  * reached, a {@code 429 Too Many Requests} response is returned.
22:  *
23:  * To test the limit, the Apache Bench tool ab can be used:
24:  *
25:  * <pre>
26:  * {@code
27:  *
28:  * ab -n 100  http://localhost:8080/customers
29:  *
30:  * }
31:  * </pre>
32:  *
33:  * In the output you should see that all 100 requests were answered but 40 had a
34:  * Non-2xx response:
35:  *
36:  * <pre>
37:  * {@code
38:  *
39:  * Complete requests:      100
40:  * Failed requests:        40
41:  * Non-2xx responses:      40
42:  *
43:  * }
44:  * </pre>
45:  *
46:  * Note that the Rate Limiting library uses an in-memory store for the rate
47:  * limits, so you can simply restart the server to reset the limit.
48:  *
49:  * This interceptor is configured in {@link WebConfiguration} to intercept all
50:  * requests to this application.
51:  *
52:  * @see <a href=
53:  *      "https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/qualityManagementAndGovernance/RateLimit">https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/qualityManagementAndGovernance/RateLimit</a>
54:  */
55: @Component
56: public class RateLimitInterceptor implements HandlerInterceptor {
57: 	private Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
58: 	private RequestRateLimiter requestRateLimiter;
59: 	private int requestsPerMinute;
60: 	@Autowired
61: 	public RateLimitInterceptor(@Value("${rate.limit.perMinute}") int requestsPerMinute) {
62: 		this.requestsPerMinute = requestsPerMinute;
63: 		Set<RequestLimitRule> rules = Collections
64: 				.singleton(RequestLimitRule.of(1, TimeUnit.MINUTES, requestsPerMinute));
65: 		requestRateLimiter = new InMemorySlidingWindowRequestRateLimiter(rules);
66: 	}
67: 	@Override
68: 	public boolean preHandle(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, Object object) throws Exception {
69: 		String clientRemoteAddr = request.getRemoteAddr();
70: 		boolean overLimit = requestRateLimiter.overLimitWhenIncremented(clientRemoteAddr);
71: 		if (overLimit) {
72: 			logger.info("Client " + clientRemoteAddr + " has been rate limited.");
73: 			response.setStatus(HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS.value());
74: 		}
75: 		response.addHeader("X-RateLimit-Limit", String.valueOf(requestsPerMinute));
76: 		return !overLimit;
77: 	}
78: }

 9: /**
10:  * This class defines that the response to unauthorized requests should be HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
11:  */
12: @Component
13: public class UnauthorizedHandler implements AuthenticationEntryPoint {
14: 	@Override
15: 	public void commence(HttpServletRequest httpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse httpServletResponse,
16: 			AuthenticationException e) throws IOException, ServletException {

12: /**
13:  * The WebConfiguration class is used to customize the default Spring MVC configuration.
14:  * */
15: @Configuration
16: public class WebConfiguration implements WebMvcConfigurer {
17: 	@Autowired
18: 	HandlerInterceptor rateLimitInterceptor;
19: 	/**
20: 	 * This method adds a custom interceptor to the InterceptorRegistry in order to enable rate-limiting.
21: 	 * */
22: 	@Override
23: 	public void addInterceptors(InterceptorRegistry registry) {
24: 		registry.addInterceptor(rateLimitInterceptor);
25: 	}
26: 	/**
27: 	 * This web servlet makes the web console of the H2 database engine available at the "/console" endpoint.
28: 	 * */
29: 	@Bean
30: 	public ServletRegistrationBean<WebServlet> h2servletRegistration() {
31: 		ServletRegistrationBean<WebServlet> registrationBean = new ServletRegistrationBean<>(new WebServlet());
32: 		registrationBean.addUrlMappings("/console/*");
33: 		return registrationBean;
34: 	}
35: 	/**
36: 	 * This is a filter that generates an ETag value based on the content of the response. This ETag is compared to the If-None-Match header
37: 	 * of the request. If these headers are equal, the response content is not sent, but rather a 304 "Not Modified" status instead.
38: 	 * */
39: 	@Bean
40: 	public Filter shallowETagHeaderFilter() {
41: 		return new ShallowEtagHeaderFilter();
42: 	}

 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.interfaces.configuration;
 2: import java.util.Arrays;
 3: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
 4: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
 5: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
 6: import org.springframework.http.HttpMethod;
 7: import org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationManager;
 8: import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.authentication.builders.AuthenticationManagerBuilder;
 9: import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.method.configuration.EnableGlobalMethodSecurity;
10: import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
11: import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configuration.EnableWebSecurity;
12: import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configuration.WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter;
13: import org.springframework.security.config.http.SessionCreationPolicy;
14: import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService;
15: import org.springframework.security.crypto.bcrypt.BCryptPasswordEncoder;
16: import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter;
17: import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfiguration;
18: import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfigurationSource;
19: import org.springframework.web.cors.UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource;
20: /**
21:  * The WebSecurityConfiguration class configures the security policies used for the exposed HTTP resource API.
22:  * In this case, it ensures that only authenticated users can access the API.
23:  */
24: @Configuration
25: @EnableWebSecurity
26: @EnableGlobalMethodSecurity(prePostEnabled = true)
27: public class WebSecurityConfiguration extends WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter {
28: 	private static final String[] AUTH_WHITELIST = {
29: 			// -- swagger ui
30: 			"/swagger-resources/**",
31: 			"/swagger-ui/**",
32: 			"/v2/api-docs",
33: 			"/webjars/**",
34: 			// spring-boot-starter-actuator health checks and other info
35: 			"/actuator/**",
36: 			"/actuator",
37: 			// Other whitelisted endpoints,
38: 			"/customers",
39: 			"/customers/**",
40: 			"/cities",
41: 			"/cities/**",
42: 			"/insurance-quote-requests",
43: 			"/insurance-quote-requests/**",
44: 	};
45: 	@Autowired
46: 	private UnauthorizedHandler unauthorizedHandler;
47: 	@Autowired
48: 	private UserDetailsService userDetailsService;
49: 	@Bean
50: 	@Override
51: 	public AuthenticationManager authenticationManagerBean() throws Exception {
52: 		return super.authenticationManagerBean();
53: 	}
54: 	@Bean
55: 	public AuthenticationTokenFilter authenticationTokenFilterBean() throws Exception {
56: 		AuthenticationTokenFilter authenticationTokenFilter = new AuthenticationTokenFilter();
57: 		authenticationTokenFilter.setAuthenticationManager(authenticationManagerBean());
58: 		return authenticationTokenFilter;
59: 	}
60: 	@Override
61: 	protected void configure(HttpSecurity httpSecurity) throws Exception {
62: 		httpSecurity.headers().frameOptions().disable().and().cors().and().csrf().disable().exceptionHandling()
63: 		.authenticationEntryPoint(this.unauthorizedHandler).and().sessionManagement()
64: 		.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS).and().authorizeRequests()
65: 		.antMatchers(HttpMethod.OPTIONS, "/**").permitAll().antMatchers("/auth/**").permitAll().and()
66: 		.authorizeRequests().antMatchers("/console/**").permitAll()
67: 		.antMatchers(AUTH_WHITELIST).permitAll().anyRequest().authenticated();
68: 		httpSecurity.addFilterBefore(authenticationTokenFilterBean(), UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter.class);
69: 		// Disable Cache-Control for Conditional Requests
70: 		httpSecurity.headers().cacheControl().disable();
71: 	}
72: 	@Autowired
73: 	public void configureAuthentication(AuthenticationManagerBuilder authenticationManagerBuilder) throws Exception {
74: 		authenticationManagerBuilder.userDetailsService(this.userDetailsService)
75: 		.passwordEncoder(new BCryptPasswordEncoder());
76: 	}
77: 	@Bean
78: 	public CorsConfigurationSource corsConfigurationSource() {
79: 		CorsConfiguration configuration = new CorsConfiguration();
80: 		configuration.setAllowedOrigins(Arrays.asList("*"));
81: 		configuration.setAllowedMethods(Arrays.asList("GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"));
82: 		configuration.setAllowedHeaders(Arrays.asList("authorization", "content-type", "x-auth-token"));
83: 		configuration.setExposedHeaders(Arrays.asList("x-auth-token"));
84: 		UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource source = new UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource();
85: 		source.registerCorsConfiguration("/**", configuration);
86: 		return source;
87: 	}
88: }

  1: package com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.interfaces;
  2: import static org.springframework.hateoas.server.mvc.WebMvcLinkBuilder.linkTo;
  3: import static org.springframework.hateoas.server.mvc.WebMvcLinkBuilder.methodOn;
  4: import java.util.List;
  5: import java.util.stream.Collectors;
  6: import javax.validation.Valid;
  7: import org.slf4j.Logger;
  8: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
  9: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
 10: import org.springframework.hateoas.Link;
 11: import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
 12: import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
 13: import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
 14: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
 15: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
 16: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
 17: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PutMapping;
 18: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
 19: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
 20: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
 21: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.domain.customer.CustomerId;
 22: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.domain.identityaccess.UserLoginEntity;
 23: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.domain.insurancequoterequest.InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot;
 24: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.infrastructure.CustomerCoreRemoteProxy;
 25: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.infrastructure.InsuranceQuoteRequestRepository;
 26: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.infrastructure.UserLoginRepository;
 27: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.interfaces.dtos.customer.AddressDto;

 30: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.interfaces.dtos.customer.CustomerProfileUpdateRequestDto;
 31: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.interfaces.dtos.customer.CustomerRegistrationRequestDto;
 32: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.interfaces.dtos.insurancequoterequest.InsuranceQuoteRequestDto;
 33: import io.swagger.annotations.ApiOperation;
 34: import io.swagger.annotations.ApiParam;
 35: /**
 36:  * This REST controller gives clients access to the customer data. It is an example of the
 37:  * <i>Information Holder Resource</i> pattern. This particular one is a special type of information holder called <i>Master Data Holder</i>.
 38:  *
 39:  * @see <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/responsibility/endpointRoles/InformationHolderResource">Information Holder Resource</a>
 40:  * @see <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/responsibility/informationHolderEndpointTypes/MasterDataHolder">Master Data Holder</a>
 41:  */
 42: @RestController
 43: @RequestMapping("/customers")
 44: public class CustomerInformationHolder {
 45: 	private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
 46: 	@Autowired
 47: 	private UserLoginRepository userLoginRepository;
 48: 	@Autowired
 49: 	private InsuranceQuoteRequestRepository insuranceQuoteRequestRepository;
 50: 	@Autowired
 51: 	private CustomerCoreRemoteProxy customerCoreRemoteProxy;
 52: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Change a customer's address.")
 53: 	@PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()")
 54: 	@PutMapping(value = "/{customerId}/address")
 55: 	public ResponseEntity<AddressDto> changeAddress(
 56: 			@ApiParam(value = "the customer's unique id", required = true) @PathVariable CustomerId customerId,
 57: 			@ApiParam(value = "the customer's new address", required = true) @Valid @RequestBody AddressDto requestDto) {
 58: 		return customerCoreRemoteProxy.changeAddress(customerId, requestDto);
 59: 	}
 60: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Get customer with a given customer id.")
 61: 	@PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()")
 62: 	@GetMapping(value = "/{customerId}")
 63: 	public ResponseEntity<CustomerDto> getCustomer(
 64: 			Authentication authentication,
 65: 			@ApiParam(value = "the customer's unique id", required = true) @PathVariable CustomerId customerId) {
 66: 		CustomerDto customer = customerCoreRemoteProxy.getCustomer(customerId);
 67: 		if(customer == null) {
 68: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to find a customer with id '" + customerId.getId() + "'.";
 69: 			logger.info(errorMessage);
 70: 			throw new CustomerNotFoundException(errorMessage);
 71: 		}
 72: 		addHATEOASLinks(customer);
 73: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(customer);
 74: 	}
 75: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Complete the registration of a new customer.")
 76: 	@PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()")
 77: 	@PostMapping
 78: 	public ResponseEntity<CustomerDto> registerCustomer(
 79: 			Authentication authentication,
 80: 			@ApiParam(value = "the customer's profile information", required = true) @Valid @RequestBody CustomerRegistrationRequestDto requestDto) {
 81: 		String loggedInUserEmail = authentication.getName();
 82: 		CustomerProfileUpdateRequestDto dto = new CustomerProfileUpdateRequestDto(
 83: 				requestDto.getFirstname(), requestDto.getLastname(), requestDto.getBirthday(), requestDto.getStreetAddress(),
 84: 				requestDto.getPostalCode(), requestDto.getCity(), loggedInUserEmail, requestDto.getPhoneNumber());
 85: 		CustomerDto customer = customerCoreRemoteProxy.createCustomer(dto);
 86: 		UserLoginEntity loggedInUser = userLoginRepository.findByEmail(loggedInUserEmail);
 87: 		loggedInUser.setCustomerId(new CustomerId(customer.getCustomerId()));
 88: 		userLoginRepository.save(loggedInUser);
 89: 		addHATEOASLinks(customer);
 90: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(customer);
 91: 	}
 92: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Get a customer's insurance quote requests.")
 93: 	@PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()")
 94: 	@GetMapping(value = "/{customerId}/insurance-quote-requests")
 95: 	public ResponseEntity<List<InsuranceQuoteRequestDto>> getInsuranceQuoteRequests(
 96: 			@ApiParam(value = "the customer's unique id", required = true) @PathVariable CustomerId customerId) {
 97: 		List<InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot> insuranceQuoteRequests = insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.findByCustomerInfo_CustomerIdOrderByDateDesc(customerId);
 98: 		List<InsuranceQuoteRequestDto> insuranceQuoteRequestDtos = insuranceQuoteRequests.stream().map(InsuranceQuoteRequestDto::fromDomainObject).collect(Collectors.toList());
 99: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(insuranceQuoteRequestDtos);
100: 	}
101: 	private void addHATEOASLinks(CustomerDto customerDto) {
102: 		CustomerId customerId = new CustomerId(customerDto.getCustomerId());
103: 		Link selfLink = linkTo(methodOn(CustomerInformationHolder.class).getCustomer(null, customerId))
104: 				.withSelfRel();
105: 		Link updateAddressLink = linkTo(methodOn(CustomerInformationHolder.class).changeAddress(customerId, null))
106: 				.withRel("address.change");
107: 		// When getting the DTO from the proxy, it already contains links
108: 		// pointing to the customer-core, so we first remove them ...
109: 		customerDto.removeLinks();
110: 		// and add our own:
111: 		customerDto.add(selfLink);
112: 		customerDto.add(updateAddressLink);
113: 	}
114: }

 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.interfaces;
 2: import java.util.Optional;
 3: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 4: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 5: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
 6: import org.springframework.jms.annotation.JmsListener;
 7: import org.springframework.messaging.Message;
 8: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
 9: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.domain.insurancequoterequest.InsuranceQuoteExpiredEvent;
10: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.domain.insurancequoterequest.InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot;
11: import com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.infrastructure.InsuranceQuoteRequestRepository;
12: /**
13:  * InsuranceQuoteExpiredMessageConsumer is a Spring component that consumes InsuranceQuoteExpiredEvents
14:  * as they arrive through the ActiveMQ message queue. It processes these events by marking the corresponding
15:  * insurance quote requests as expired.
16:  * */
17: @Component
18: public class InsuranceQuoteExpiredMessageConsumer {
19: 	private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
20: 	@Autowired
21: 	private InsuranceQuoteRequestRepository insuranceQuoteRequestRepository;
22: 	@JmsListener(destination = "${insuranceQuoteExpiredEvent.queueName}")
23: 	public void receiveInsuranceQuoteExpiredEvent(final Message<InsuranceQuoteExpiredEvent> message) {
24: 		logger.info("A new InsuranceQuoteResponseEvent has been received.");
25: 		final InsuranceQuoteExpiredEvent insuranceQuoteExpiredEvent = message.getPayload();
26: 		final Long id = insuranceQuoteExpiredEvent.getInsuranceQuoteRequestId();
27: 		final Optional<InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot> insuranceQuoteRequestOpt = insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.findById(id);
28: 		if(!insuranceQuoteRequestOpt.isPresent()) {
29: 			logger.error("Unable to process an insurance quote expired event with an invalid insurance quote request id.");
30: 			return;
31: 		}
32: 		final InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot insuranceQuoteRequest = insuranceQuoteRequestOpt.get();
33: 		insuranceQuoteRequest.markQuoteAsExpired(insuranceQuoteExpiredEvent.getDate());
34: 		logger.info("The insurance quote for insurance quote request " + insuranceQuoteRequest.getId() + " has expired.");
35: 		insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.save(insuranceQuoteRequest);
36: 	}
37: }

 36: /**
 37:  * This REST controller gives clients access to the insurance quote requests. It is an example of the

 41:  *

 43:  * 
 44:  *  * @see <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/responsibility/endpointRoles/ProcessingResource">Processing Resource</a>
 45:  *  
 46:  *Matching RDD role stereotypes are <i>Coordinator</i> and <i>Information Holder</i>:

 48:  *  * @see <a href="http://www.wirfs-brock.com/PDFs/A_Brief-Tour-of-RDD.pdf">A Brief Tour of RDD</a>
 49:  */
 50: @RestController
 51: @RequestMapping("/insurance-quote-requests")
 52: public class InsuranceQuoteRequestCoordinator {
 53: 	private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
 54: 	@Autowired
 55: 	private InsuranceQuoteRequestRepository insuranceQuoteRequestRepository;
 56: 	@Autowired
 57: 	private UserLoginRepository userLoginRepository;
 58: 	@Autowired
 59: 	private PolicyManagementMessageProducer policyManagementMessageProducer;
 60: 	/**
 61: 	 * This endpoint is only used for debugging purposes.
 62: 	 * */
 63: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Get all Insurance Quote Requests.")
 64: 	@GetMapping /* MAP: Retrieval Operation */ 
 65: 	public ResponseEntity<List<InsuranceQuoteRequestDto>> getInsuranceQuoteRequests() {
 66: 		List<InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot> quoteRequests = insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.findAllByOrderByDateDesc();
 67: 		List<InsuranceQuoteRequestDto> quoteRequestDtos = quoteRequests.stream().map(InsuranceQuoteRequestDto::fromDomainObject).collect(Collectors.toList());
 68: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(quoteRequestDtos);
 69: 	}
 70: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Get a specific Insurance Quote Request.")
 71: 	@PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()")
 72: 	@GetMapping(value = "/{insuranceQuoteRequestId}") /* MAP: Retrieval Operation */ 
 73: 	public ResponseEntity<InsuranceQuoteRequestDto> getInsuranceQuoteRequest(
 74: 			Authentication authentication,
 75: 			@ApiParam(value = "the insurance quote request's unique id", required = true) @PathVariable Long insuranceQuoteRequestId) {
 76: 		Optional<InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot> optInsuranceQuoteRequest = insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.findById(insuranceQuoteRequestId);
 77: 		if(!optInsuranceQuoteRequest.isPresent()) {
 78: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to find an insurance quote request with id '" + insuranceQuoteRequestId + "'.";
 79: 			logger.info(errorMessage);
 80: 			throw new InsuranceQuoteRequestNotFoundException(errorMessage);
 81: 		}
 82: 		InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot insuranceQuoteRequest = optInsuranceQuoteRequest.get();
 83: 		CustomerId loggedInCustomerId = userLoginRepository.findByEmail(authentication.getName()).getCustomerId();
 84: 		if (!insuranceQuoteRequest.getCustomerInfo().getCustomerId().equals(loggedInCustomerId)) {
 85: 			logger.info("Can't access an Insurance Quote Request of a different customer.");
 86: 			return new ResponseEntity<>(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED);
 87: 		}
 88: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(InsuranceQuoteRequestDto.fromDomainObject(insuranceQuoteRequest));
 89: 	}
 90: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Create a new Insurance Quote Request.")
 91: 	@PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()")
 92: 	@PostMapping /* MAP: State Creation Operation */ 
 93: 	public ResponseEntity<InsuranceQuoteRequestDto> createInsuranceQuoteRequest(
 94: 			Authentication authentication,
 95: 			@ApiParam(value = "the insurance quote request", required = true) @Valid @RequestBody InsuranceQuoteRequestDto requestDto) {
 96: 		String loggedInUserEmail = authentication.getName();
 97: 		UserLoginEntity loggedInUser = userLoginRepository.findByEmail(loggedInUserEmail);
 98: 		CustomerId loggedInCustomerId = loggedInUser.getCustomerId();
 99: 		if (loggedInCustomerId == null) {
100: 			logger.info("Customer needs to complete registration first.");
101: 			return new ResponseEntity<>(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED);
102: 		}
103: 		CustomerInfoDto customerInfoDto = requestDto.getCustomerInfo();
104: 		CustomerId customerId = new CustomerId(customerInfoDto.getCustomerId());
105: 		if (!customerId.equals(loggedInCustomerId)) {
106: 			logger.info("Can't create an Insurance Quote Request for a different customer.");
107: 			return new ResponseEntity<>(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED);
108: 		}
109: 		CustomerInfoEntity customerInfoEntity = customerInfoDto.toDomainObject();
110: 		InsuranceOptionsEntity insuranceOptionsEntity = requestDto.getInsuranceOptions().toDomainObject();
111: 		final Date date = new Date();
112: 		InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot insuranceQuoteRequest = new InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot(date, RequestStatus.REQUEST_SUBMITTED, customerInfoEntity, insuranceOptionsEntity, null, null);
113: 		insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.save(insuranceQuoteRequest);
114: 		InsuranceQuoteRequestDto responseDto = InsuranceQuoteRequestDto.fromDomainObject(insuranceQuoteRequest);
115: 		policyManagementMessageProducer.sendInsuranceQuoteRequest(date, responseDto);
116: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(responseDto);
117: 	}
118: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Updates the status of an existing Insurance Quote Request")
119: 	@PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()")
120: 	@PatchMapping(value = "/{id}") /* MAP: State Transition Operation */ 
121: 	public ResponseEntity<InsuranceQuoteRequestDto> respondToInsuranceQuote(
122: 			Authentication authentication,
123: 			@ApiParam(value = "the insurance quote request's unique id", required = true) @PathVariable Long id,
124: 			@ApiParam(value = "the response that contains the customer's decision whether to accept or reject an insurance quote", required = true)
125: 			@Valid @RequestBody InsuranceQuoteResponseDto insuranceQuoteResponseDto) {
126: 		String loggedInUserEmail = authentication.getName();
127: 		UserLoginEntity loggedInUser = userLoginRepository.findByEmail(loggedInUserEmail);
128: 		CustomerId loggedInCustomerId = loggedInUser.getCustomerId();
129: 		if (loggedInCustomerId == null) {
130: 			logger.info("Customer needs to complete registration first.");
131: 			return new ResponseEntity<>(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED);
132: 		}
133: 		Optional<InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot> optInsuranceQuoteRequest = insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.findById(id);
134: 		if (!optInsuranceQuoteRequest.isPresent()) {
135: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to respond to insurance quote, because there is no insurance quote request with id '" + id + "'.";
136: 			logger.info(errorMessage);
137: 			throw new InsuranceQuoteRequestNotFoundException(errorMessage);
138: 		}
139: 		final InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot insuranceQuoteRequest = optInsuranceQuoteRequest.get();
140: 		CustomerId customerId = insuranceQuoteRequest.getCustomerInfo().getCustomerId();
141: 		if (!customerId.equals(loggedInCustomerId)) {
142: 			logger.info("Can't update an Insurance Quote Request of a different customer.");
143: 			return new ResponseEntity<>(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED);
144: 		}
145: 		final Date date = new Date();
146: 		if(insuranceQuoteResponseDto.getStatus().equals(RequestStatus.QUOTE_ACCEPTED.toString())) {
147: 			logger.info("Insurance Quote has been accepted.");
148: 			insuranceQuoteRequest.acceptQuote(date);
149: 			policyManagementMessageProducer.sendCustomerDecision(date, insuranceQuoteRequest.getId(), true);
150: 		} else if(insuranceQuoteResponseDto.getStatus().equals(RequestStatus.QUOTE_REJECTED.toString())) {
151: 			logger.info("Insurance Quote has been rejected.");
152: 			insuranceQuoteRequest.rejectQuote(date);
153: 			policyManagementMessageProducer.sendCustomerDecision(date, insuranceQuoteRequest.getId(), false);
154: 		}
155: 		insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.save(insuranceQuoteRequest);
156: 		InsuranceQuoteRequestDto insuranceQuoteRequestDto = InsuranceQuoteRequestDto.fromDomainObject(insuranceQuoteRequest);
157: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(insuranceQuoteRequestDto);
158: 	}
159: }

25: 	@JmsListener(destination = "${insuranceQuoteResponseEvent.queueName}")
26: 	public void receiveInsuranceQuoteResponse(final Message<InsuranceQuoteResponseEvent> message) {
27: 		logger.info("A new InsuranceQuoteResponseEvent has been received.");
28: 		final InsuranceQuoteResponseEvent insuranceQuoteResponseEvent = message.getPayload();
29: 		final Long id = insuranceQuoteResponseEvent.getInsuranceQuoteRequestId();
30: 		final Optional<InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot> insuranceQuoteRequestOpt = insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.findById(id);
31: 		if(!insuranceQuoteRequestOpt.isPresent()) {
32: 			logger.error("Unable to process an insurance quote response event with an invalid insurance quote request id.");
33: 			return;
34: 		}
35: 		final Date date = insuranceQuoteResponseEvent.getDate();
36: 		final InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot insuranceQuoteRequest = insuranceQuoteRequestOpt.get();
37: 		if(insuranceQuoteResponseEvent.isRequestAccepted()) {
38: 			logger.info("The insurance quote request " + insuranceQuoteRequest.getId() + " has been accepted.");
39: 			Date expirationDate = insuranceQuoteResponseEvent.getExpirationDate();
40: 			MoneyAmount insurancePremium = insuranceQuoteResponseEvent.getInsurancePremium().toDomainObject();
41: 			MoneyAmount policyLimit = insuranceQuoteResponseEvent.getPolicyLimit().toDomainObject();
42: 			InsuranceQuoteEntity insuranceQuote = new InsuranceQuoteEntity(expirationDate, insurancePremium, policyLimit);
43: 			insuranceQuoteRequest.acceptRequest(insuranceQuote, date);
44: 		} else {
45: 			logger.info("The insurance quote request " + insuranceQuoteRequest.getId() + " has been rejected.");
46: 			insuranceQuoteRequest.rejectRequest(date);
47: 		}
48: 		insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.save(insuranceQuoteRequest);
49: 	}
50: }

12: /**
13:  * PolicyCreatedMessageConsumer is a Spring component that consumes PolicyCreatedEvents
14:  * as they arrive through the ActiveMQ message queue. It processes these events by updating
15:  * the status of the corresponding insurance quote requests.
16:  * */
17: @Component
18: public class PolicyCreatedMessageConsumer {
19: 	private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
20: 	@Autowired
21: 	private InsuranceQuoteRequestRepository insuranceQuoteRequestRepository;
22: 	@JmsListener(destination = "${policyCreatedEvent.queueName}")
23: 	public void receivePolicyCreatedEvent(final Message<PolicyCreatedEvent> message) {
24: 		logger.info("A new PolicyCreatedEvent has been received.");
25: 		final PolicyCreatedEvent policyCreatedEvent = message.getPayload();
26: 		final Long id = policyCreatedEvent.getInsuranceQuoteRequestId();
27: 		final Optional<InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot> insuranceQuoteRequestOpt = insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.findById(id);
28: 		if(!insuranceQuoteRequestOpt.isPresent()) {
29: 			logger.error("Unable to process a policy created event with an invalid insurance quote request id.");
30: 			return;
31: 		}
32: 		final InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot insuranceQuoteRequest = insuranceQuoteRequestOpt.get();
33: 		insuranceQuoteRequest.finalizeQuote(policyCreatedEvent.getPolicyId(), policyCreatedEvent.getDate());
34: 		logger.info("The insurance quote for insurance quote request " + insuranceQuoteRequest.getId() + " has expired.");
35: 		insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.save(insuranceQuoteRequest);

13: /**
14:  * This REST controller gives clients access to the current user. It is an example of the
15:  * <i>Information Holder Resource</i> pattern. This particular one is a special type of information holder called <i>Master Data Holder</i>.
16:  *
17:  * @see <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/responsibility/endpointRoles/InformationHolderResource">Information Holder Resource</a>

21: @RequestMapping("/user")
22: public class UserInformationHolder {
23: 	@Autowired
24: 	private UserLoginRepository userLoginRepository;
25: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Get the user details for the currently logged-in user.")

File: customer-self-service-backend/src/main/java/com/lakesidemutual/customerselfservice/interfaces/validation/PhoneNumberValidator.java
================
 1: package com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.interfaces.validation;
 2: import javax.validation.ConstraintValidator;
 3: import javax.validation.ConstraintValidatorContext;
 4: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 5: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 6: import com.google.i18n.phonenumbers.NumberParseException;
 7: import com.google.i18n.phonenumbers.PhoneNumberUtil;
 8: import com.google.i18n.phonenumbers.Phonenumber;
 9: /**
10:  * This class validates phone numbers using Google's libphonenumber (see https://github.com/googlei18n/libphonenumber).
11:  * */
12: public class PhoneNumberValidator implements ConstraintValidator<PhoneNumber, String> {
13: 	private Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
14: 	@Override
15: 	public boolean isValid(String phoneNumberStr, ConstraintValidatorContext context) {
16: 		PhoneNumberUtil phoneUtil = PhoneNumberUtil.getInstance();
17: 		try {
18: 			Phonenumber.PhoneNumber phoneNumber = phoneUtil.parse(phoneNumberStr, "CH");
19: 			return phoneUtil.isValidNumber(phoneNumber);
20: 		} catch (NumberParseException e) {
21: 			logger.info("'" + phoneNumberStr + "' is not a valid phone number.", e);
22: 			return false;
23: 		}
24: 	}
25: }

File: customer-self-service-frontend/Dockerfile

 1: FROM node:10 as build
 2: WORKDIR /usr/src/app
 3: COPY package.json ./
 4: COPY package-lock.json ./
 5: RUN npm install
 6: COPY . ./
 7: RUN npm run build
 8: 
 9: FROM nginx:stable-alpine
10: COPY nginx.vh.default.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
11: COPY --from=build /usr/src/app/build /usr/share/nginx/html
12: EXPOSE 80
13: WORKDIR /usr/share/nginx/html
14: 
15: RUN apk add --no-cache nodejs npm
16: RUN npm install -g @beam-australia/react-env@2.1.2
17: ADD entrypoint.sh /var/entrypoint.sh
18: ENTRYPOINT ["/var/entrypoint.sh"]
19: 
20: CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]

  3: # applications in a single command. Note that the applications will all
  4: # run in production mode, so there won't be any live-reloading of changes
  5: # or other development features. For development, we recommend to start
  6: # the applications invidually or use the run_all_applications scripts.
  7: #
  8: # Since the Dockerfiles use BuildKit features, you have to set the
  9: # DOCKER_BUILDKIT environment variable accordingly.
 10: #
 11: # To build the Docker images:
 12: #   COMPOSE_DOCKER_CLI_BUILD=1 DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker-compose -f docker-compose-eureka.yml build
 13: #
 14: # To run the applications:
 15: #   COMPOSE_DOCKER_CLI_BUILD=1 DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker-compose -f docker-compose-eureka.yml up

22: /**
23:  * The run() method of the DataLoader class is automatically executed when the application launches.
24:  * It populates the database with sample policies that can be used to test the application.
25:  * */
26: @Component
27: public class DataLoader implements ApplicationRunner {
28: 	@Autowired
29: 	private PolicyRepository policyRepository;
30: 	private Logger logger = Logger.getLogger(this.getClass().getName());
31: 	@Override
32: 	public void run(ApplicationArguments args) throws ParseException {
33: 		if(policyRepository.count() > 0) {
34: 			logger.info("Skipping import of application dummy data, because the database already contains existing entities.");
35: 			return;
36: 		}
37: 		PolicyId policyId = new PolicyId("fvo5pkqerr");
38: 		CustomerId customerId = new CustomerId("rgpp0wkpec");
39: 		Date startDate = new GregorianCalendar(2018, Calendar.FEBRUARY, 5).getTime();
40: 		Date endDate = new GregorianCalendar(2018, Calendar.FEBRUARY, 10).getTime();
41: 		PolicyPeriod policyPeriod = new PolicyPeriod(startDate, endDate);
42: 		PolicyType policyType = new PolicyType("Health Insurance");
43: 		MoneyAmount deductible = new MoneyAmount(BigDecimal.valueOf(1500), Currency.getInstance("CHF"));
44: 		MoneyAmount policyLimit = new MoneyAmount(BigDecimal.valueOf(1000000), Currency.getInstance("CHF"));
45: 		MoneyAmount insurancePremium = new MoneyAmount(BigDecimal.valueOf(250), Currency.getInstance("CHF"));
46: 		InsuringAgreementEntity insuringAgreement = new InsuringAgreementEntity(Collections.emptyList());
47: 		PolicyAggregateRoot policy = new PolicyAggregateRoot(policyId, customerId, new Date(), policyPeriod, policyType,
48: 				deductible, policyLimit, insurancePremium, insuringAgreement);
49: 		policyRepository.save(policy);
50: 		logger.info("DataLoader has successfully imported all application dummy data, the application is now ready.");
51: 	}
52: }

File: policy-management-backend/src/main/java/com/lakesidemutual/policymanagement/application/ExpirationCheckerJob.java
================
 1: package com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.application;
 2: import java.util.Date;
 3: import java.util.List;
 4: import java.util.stream.Collectors;
 5: import org.quartz.Job;
 6: import org.quartz.JobExecutionContext;
 7: import org.quartz.JobExecutionException;
 8: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 9: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
10: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
11: import com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.domain.insurancequoterequest.InsuranceQuoteExpiredEvent;
12: import com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.domain.insurancequoterequest.InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot;
13: import com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.infrastructure.CustomerSelfServiceMessageProducer;
14: import com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.infrastructure.InsuranceQuoteRequestRepository;
15: /**
16:  * ExpirationCheckerJob is a Quartz job that periodically checks for expired insurance quotes. For each
17:  * expired insurance quote, it also sends an InsuranceQuoteExpiredEvent to the Customer Self-Service backend.
18:  * */
19: public class ExpirationCheckerJob implements Job {
20: 	private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
21: 	@Autowired
22: 	private CustomerSelfServiceMessageProducer customerSelfServiceMessageProducer;
23: 	@Autowired
24: 	private InsuranceQuoteRequestRepository insuranceQuoteRequestRepository;
25: 	@Override
26: 	public void execute(JobExecutionContext context) throws JobExecutionException {
27: 		logger.debug("Checking for expired insurance quotes...");
28: 		final Date date = new Date();
29: 		List<InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot> quoteRequests = insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.findAll();
30: 		List<InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot> expiredQuoteRequests = quoteRequests.stream()
31: 				.filter(quoteRequest -> quoteRequest.checkQuoteExpirationDate(date))
32: 				.collect(Collectors.toList());
33: 		insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.saveAll(expiredQuoteRequests);
34: 		expiredQuoteRequests.forEach(expiredQuoteRequest -> {
35: 			InsuranceQuoteExpiredEvent event = new InsuranceQuoteExpiredEvent(date, expiredQuoteRequest.getId());
36: 			customerSelfServiceMessageProducer.sendInsuranceQuoteExpiredEvent(event);
37: 		});
38: 		if(expiredQuoteRequests.size() > 0) {
39: 			logger.info("Found {} expired insurance quotes", expiredQuoteRequests.size());
40: 		} else {
41: 			logger.debug("Found no expired insurance quotes");
42: 		}
43: 	}
44: }

 1: package com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.application;
 2: import org.quartz.JobDetail;
 3: import org.quartz.SimpleTrigger;
 4: import org.quartz.Trigger;
 5: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
 6: import org.springframework.context.ApplicationContext;
 7: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
 8: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
 9: import org.springframework.core.io.ClassPathResource;
10: import org.springframework.scheduling.quartz.JobDetailFactoryBean;
11: import org.springframework.scheduling.quartz.SchedulerFactoryBean;
12: import org.springframework.scheduling.quartz.SimpleTriggerFactoryBean;
13: import org.springframework.scheduling.quartz.SpringBeanJobFactory;
14: /**
15:  * The ExpirationCheckerJobConfiguration class is used to set up
16:  * the scheduler to periodically execute the ExpirationCheckerJob.
17:  * */
18: @Configuration
19: public class ExpirationCheckerJobConfiguration {
20: 	private final static int START_DELAY = 60000;
21: 	private final static int REPEAT_INTERVAL = 60000;
22: 	@Autowired
23: 	private ApplicationContext applicationContext;
24: 	@Bean
25: 	public JobDetailFactoryBean jobDetail() {
26: 		JobDetailFactoryBean jobDetailFactory = new JobDetailFactoryBean();
27: 		jobDetailFactory.setJobClass(ExpirationCheckerJob.class);
28: 		jobDetailFactory.setDescription("Invoke Expiration Checker Job...");
29: 		jobDetailFactory.setDurability(true);
30: 		return jobDetailFactory;
31: 	}
32: 	@Bean
33: 	public SimpleTriggerFactoryBean trigger(JobDetail job) {
34: 		SimpleTriggerFactoryBean trigger = new SimpleTriggerFactoryBean();
35: 		trigger.setJobDetail(job);
36: 		trigger.setStartDelay(START_DELAY);
37: 		trigger.setRepeatInterval(REPEAT_INTERVAL);
38: 		trigger.setRepeatCount(SimpleTrigger.REPEAT_INDEFINITELY);
39: 		return trigger;
40: 	}
41: 	@Bean
42: 	public SchedulerFactoryBean scheduler(Trigger trigger, JobDetail job) {
43: 		SchedulerFactoryBean schedulerFactory = new SchedulerFactoryBean();
44: 		schedulerFactory.setConfigLocation(new ClassPathResource("quartz.properties"));
45: 		schedulerFactory.setJobFactory(springBeanJobFactory());
46: 		schedulerFactory.setJobDetails(job);
47: 		schedulerFactory.setTriggers(trigger);
48: 		return schedulerFactory;
49: 	}
50: 	@Bean
51: 	public SpringBeanJobFactory springBeanJobFactory() {
52: 		SpringBeanJobFactory jobFactory = new SpringBeanJobFactory();
53: 		jobFactory.setApplicationContext(applicationContext);
54: 		return jobFactory;
55: 	}
56: }

34: 	public CustomerId(String id) {

 1: package com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.domain.insurancequoterequest;
 2: import java.util.Objects;
 3: import javax.persistence.Entity;
 4: import javax.persistence.GeneratedValue;
 5: import javax.persistence.Id;
 6: import javax.persistence.Table;
 7: import org.microserviceapipatterns.domaindrivendesign.ValueObject;
 8: /**
 9:  * An Address is a value object that is used to represent the postal address of a customer.
10:  *
11:  * You might be wondering why the Address class implements the ValueObject interface even though it has a JPA @Entity annotation.
12:  * This discrepancy exists for technical reasons. JPA requires Address to be declared as an entity, because it is part of a one-to-many
13:  * relationship. However, in the DDD sense, Address behaves like a value object.
14:  *
15:  * You also might be wondering why this code is the same as that in the Customer Core. This does violate DRY but for
16:  * good reasons: strategic DD suggests that model boundaries decouple (sub-)systems so that they can be deployed and
17:  * evolved independently.
18:  * */
19: @Entity
20: @Table(name = "addresses")
21: public class Address implements ValueObject {
22: 	@GeneratedValue
23: 	@Id
24: 	private Long id;
25: 	private final String streetAddress;
26: 	private final String postalCode;
27: 	private final String city;
28: 	public Address() {
29: 		this.streetAddress = null;
30: 		this.postalCode = null;
31: 		this.city = null;
32: 	}
33: 	public Address(String streetAddress, String postalCode, String city) {
34: 		this.streetAddress = streetAddress;
35: 		this.postalCode = postalCode;
36: 		this.city = city;
37: 	}
38: 	public String getStreetAddress() {
39: 		return streetAddress;
40: 	}
41: 	public String getPostalCode() {
42: 		return postalCode;
43: 	}
44: 	public String getCity() {
45: 		return city;
46: 	}
47: 	@Override
48: 	public String toString() {
49: 		return String.format("%s, %s %ss", streetAddress, postalCode, city);
50: 	}
51: 	@Override
52: 	public boolean equals(Object obj) {
53: 		if (this == obj) {
54: 			return true;
55: 		}
56: 		if (obj == null) {
57: 			return false;
58: 		}
59: 		if (getClass() != obj.getClass()) {
60: 			return false;
61: 		}
62: 		Address other = (Address) obj;
63: 		return Objects.equals(streetAddress, other.streetAddress) &&
64: 				Objects.equals(postalCode, other.postalCode) &&
65: 				Objects.equals(city, other.city);
66: 	}
67: 	@Override
68: 	public int hashCode() {
69: 		return Objects.hash(streetAddress, postalCode, city);
70: 	}
71: }

  1: package com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.domain.insurancequoterequest;
  2: import java.util.ArrayList;
  3: import java.util.Date;
  4: import java.util.List;
  5: import javax.persistence.CascadeType;
  6: import javax.persistence.Entity;
  7: import javax.persistence.FetchType;
  8: import javax.persistence.Id;
  9: import javax.persistence.OneToMany;
 10: import javax.persistence.OneToOne;
 11: import javax.persistence.Table;
 12: import org.microserviceapipatterns.domaindrivendesign.RootEntity;
 13: /**
 14:  * InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot is the root entity of the Insurance Quote Request aggregate. Note that there is
 15:  * no class for the Insurance Quote Request aggregate, so the package can be seen as aggregate.
 16:  */
 17: @Entity
 18: @Table(name = "insurancequoterequests")
 19: public class InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot implements RootEntity {
 20: 	@Id
 21: 	private Long id;
 22: 	private Date date;
 23: 	@OneToMany(fetch = FetchType.EAGER, cascade = CascadeType.ALL)
 24: 	private List<RequestStatusChange> statusHistory;
 25: 	@OneToOne(cascade = CascadeType.ALL)
 26: 	private CustomerInfoEntity customerInfo;
 27: 	@OneToOne(cascade = CascadeType.ALL)
 28: 	private InsuranceOptionsEntity insuranceOptions;
 29: 	@OneToOne(cascade = CascadeType.ALL)
 30: 	private InsuranceQuoteEntity insuranceQuote;
 31: 	private String policyId;
 32: 	public InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot() {}
 33: 	public InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot(Long id, Date date, RequestStatus initialStatus, CustomerInfoEntity customerInfo, InsuranceOptionsEntity insuranceOptions, InsuranceQuoteEntity insuranceQuote, String policyId) {
 34: 		this.id = id;
 35: 		this.date = date;
 36: 		List<RequestStatusChange> statusHistory = new ArrayList<>();
 37: 		statusHistory.add(new RequestStatusChange(date, initialStatus));
 38: 		this.statusHistory = statusHistory;
 39: 		this.customerInfo = customerInfo;
 40: 		this.insuranceOptions = insuranceOptions;
 41: 		this.insuranceQuote = insuranceQuote;
 42: 		this.policyId = policyId;
 43: 	}
 44: 	public Long getId() {
 45: 		return id;
 46: 	}
 47: 	public Date getDate() {
 48: 		return date;
 49: 	}
 50: 	public RequestStatus getStatus() {
 51: 		return statusHistory.get(statusHistory.size()-1).getStatus();
 52: 	}
 53: 	public List<RequestStatusChange> getStatusHistory() {
 54: 		return statusHistory;
 55: 	}
 56: 	private void changeStatusTo(RequestStatus newStatus, Date date) {
 57: 		if (!getStatus().canTransitionTo(newStatus)) {
 58: 			throw new RuntimeException(String.format("Cannot change insurance quote request status from %s to %s", getStatus(), newStatus));
 59: 		}
 60: 		statusHistory.add(new RequestStatusChange(date, newStatus));
 61: 	}
 62: 	public RequestStatusChange popStatus() {
 63: 		if(statusHistory.isEmpty()) {
 64: 			return null;
 65: 		}
 66: 		return statusHistory.remove(statusHistory.size()-1);
 67: 	}
 68: 	public void acceptRequest(InsuranceQuoteEntity insuranceQuote, Date date) {
 69: 		this.insuranceQuote = insuranceQuote;
 70: 		changeStatusTo(RequestStatus.QUOTE_RECEIVED, date);
 71: 	}
 72: 	public void rejectRequest(Date date) {
 73: 		changeStatusTo(RequestStatus.REQUEST_REJECTED, date);
 74: 	}
 75: 	public void acceptQuote(Date date) {
 76: 		changeStatusTo(RequestStatus.QUOTE_ACCEPTED, date);
 77: 	}
 78: 	public void rejectQuote(Date date) {
 79: 		changeStatusTo(RequestStatus.QUOTE_REJECTED, date);
 80: 	}
 81: 	/**
 82: 	 * Checks the quote expiration date and changes the request status to QUOTE_EXPIRED if necessary.
 83: 	 * Returns true if the request status has been changed.
 84: 	 * */
 85: 	public boolean checkQuoteExpirationDate(Date date) {
 86: 		if(getStatus().canTransitionTo(RequestStatus.QUOTE_EXPIRED) && hasQuoteExpired(date)) {
 87: 			markQuoteAsExpired(date);
 88: 			return true;
 89: 		}
 90: 		return false;
 91: 	}
 92: 	public boolean hasQuoteExpired(Date date) {
 93: 		return insuranceQuote != null && insuranceQuote.getExpirationDate().before(date);
 94: 	}
 95: 	public void markQuoteAsExpired(Date date) {
 96: 		changeStatusTo(RequestStatus.QUOTE_EXPIRED, date);
 97: 	}
 98: 	public void finalizeQuote(String policyId, Date date) {
 99: 		this.policyId = policyId;
100: 		changeStatusTo(RequestStatus.POLICY_CREATED, date);
101: 	}
102: 	public CustomerInfoEntity getCustomerInfo() {
103: 		return customerInfo;
104: 	}
105: 	public InsuranceOptionsEntity getInsuranceOptions() {
106: 		return insuranceOptions;
107: 	}
108: 	public InsuranceQuoteEntity getInsuranceQuote() {
109: 		return insuranceQuote;
110: 	}
111: 	public String getPolicyId() {
112: 		return policyId;
113: 	}
114: }

================
 1: package com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.domain.insurancequoterequest;
 2: import org.microserviceapipatterns.domaindrivendesign.ValueObject;
 3: /**
 4:  * A RequestStatus is a value object that is used to represent
 5:  * the current status of an insurance quote request.
 6:  *
 7:  * The following diagram shows the possible state transitions:
 8:  *
 9:  * <pre>
10:  *
11:  *                                               │
12:  *                                               ▼
13:  *                                        ┌────────────┐
14:  *                                        │  REQUEST_  │
15:  *                                        │ SUBMITTED  │
16:  *                                        └────────────┘
17:  *                                               │
18:  *                             ┌─────────────────┴────────────────┐
19:  *                             │                                  │
20:  *                             ▼                                  ▼
21:  *                      ┌────────────┐                     ╔════════════╗
22:  *                      │   QUOTE_   │                     ║  REQUEST_  ║
23:  *          ┌───────────│  RECEIVED  │─────────────┐       ║  REJECTED  ║
24:  *          │           └────────────┘             │       ╚════════════╝
25:  *          │                  │                   │
26:  *          │                  │                   │
27:  *          ▼                  ▼                   ▼
28:  *   ╔════════════╗     ┌────────────┐      ╔════════════╗
29:  *   ║   QUOTE_   ║     │   QUOTE_   │      ║   QUOTE_   ║
30:  *   ║  REJECTED  ║     │  ACCEPTED  │─────▶║  EXPIRED   ║
31:  *   ╚════════════╝     └────────────┘      ╚════════════╝
32:  *                             │
33:  *                             │
34:  *                             ▼
35:  *                      ╔════════════╗
36:  *                      ║  POLICY_   ║
37:  *                      ║  CREATED   ║
38:  *                      ╚════════════╝
39:  *
40:  * </pre>
41:  */
42: public enum RequestStatus implements ValueObject {
43: 	/** The customer has submitted a request. No answer has been received yet. */
44: 	REQUEST_SUBMITTED,
45: 	/** Lakeside Mutual has rejected the request. No quote has been made. */
46: 	REQUEST_REJECTED,
47: 	/** Lakeside Mutual has accepted the request and made a corresponding quote. */
48: 	QUOTE_RECEIVED,
49: 	/** The customer has accepted Lakeside Mutual's quote. */
50: 	QUOTE_ACCEPTED,
51: 	/** The customer has rejected Lakeside Mutual's quote. */
52: 	QUOTE_REJECTED,
53: 	/** The quote has expired and is no longer valid. */
54: 	QUOTE_EXPIRED,
55: 	/** A new insurance policy has been created. */
56: 	POLICY_CREATED;
57: 	public boolean canTransitionTo(RequestStatus newStatus) {
58: 		switch(this) {
59: 		case REQUEST_SUBMITTED:
60: 			return newStatus == REQUEST_REJECTED || newStatus == QUOTE_RECEIVED;
61: 		case QUOTE_RECEIVED:
62: 			return newStatus == QUOTE_ACCEPTED || newStatus == QUOTE_REJECTED || newStatus == QUOTE_EXPIRED;
63: 		case QUOTE_ACCEPTED:
64: 			return newStatus == POLICY_CREATED || newStatus == QUOTE_EXPIRED;
65: 		case REQUEST_REJECTED:
66: 		case POLICY_CREATED:
67: 		case QUOTE_REJECTED:
68: 		case QUOTE_EXPIRED:
69: 			return false;
70: 		default:
71: 			return false;
72: 		}
73: 	}
74: }

 1: package com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.domain.insurancequoterequest;

 4: import javax.persistence.Embeddable;

11: import org.microserviceapipatterns.domaindrivendesign.ValueObject;
12: /**
13:  * An instance of RequestStatusChange is a value object that represents a status change
14:  * of an insurance quote request. It contains the date of the status change as well as the new status.
15:  */
16: @Entity
17: @Table(name = "requeststatuschanges")
18: @Embeddable

 1: package com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.domain.policy;
 2: import java.math.BigDecimal;

 4: import java.util.Objects;
 5: import javax.persistence.Embeddable;
 6: import org.microserviceapipatterns.domaindrivendesign.ValueObject;
 7: /**
 8:  * An instance of MoneyAmount is a value object that represents an amount of money in a specific currency.
 9:  * For example, this is used to represent the insurance premium of a policy.
10:  */
11: @Embeddable
12: public class MoneyAmount implements ValueObject {
13: 	private BigDecimal amount;
14: 	private Currency currency;
15: 	public MoneyAmount() {}
16: 	public MoneyAmount(BigDecimal amount, Currency currency) {
17: 		Objects.requireNonNull(amount);
18: 		Objects.requireNonNull(currency);
19: 		this.amount = amount;
20: 		this.currency = currency;
21: 	}
22: 	public BigDecimal getAmount() {
23: 		return amount;
24: 	}
25: 	public Currency getCurrency() {
26: 		return currency;
27: 	}
28: 	@Override
29: 	public boolean equals(Object obj) {
30: 		if (this == obj) {
31: 			return true;
32: 		}
33: 		if (obj == null) {
34: 			return false;
35: 		}
36: 		if (getClass() != obj.getClass()) {
37: 			return false;
38: 		}
39: 		MoneyAmount other = (MoneyAmount) obj;
40: 		if(amount.compareTo(other.amount) != 0) {
41: 			return false;
42: 		}
43: 		if(!currency.equals(other.currency)) {
44: 			return false;
45: 		}
46: 		return true;
47: 	}
48: 	@Override
49: 	public int hashCode() {
50: 		return Objects.hash(amount, currency);
51: 	}
52: }

 16:  * PolicyAggregateRoot is the root entity of the Policy aggregate. Note that there is

 18:  */
 19: @MADR(
 20: 		value = 2,
 21: 		title = "Separation between domain data model and infrastructure data model",
 22: 		contextAndProblem = "JPA / Spring Data annotations usually belong into a separate data model in the infrastructure layer",
 23: 		alternatives = {
 24: 				"Keep the JPA / Spring Data annotations in the domain data model",
 25: 				"Implement a separate data model with JPA / Spring Data annotations in the infrastructure layer",
 26: 		},
 27: 		chosenAlternative = "Keep the JPA / Spring Data annotations in the domain data model",
 28: 		justification = "The relatively small size of this application does not warrant the additional complexity (yet)."
 29: 		)

 36: 	@AttributeOverrides({

 38: 	private CustomerId customerId;

 41: 	 *
 42: 	 * policyRepository.findAll(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.DESC, PolicyAggregateRoot.FIELD_CREATION_DATE));
 43: 	 *
 44: 	 * Using a constant that contains the field name, we can don't have to use string literals to reference the field name. This also
 45: 	 * improves the maintainability of the code, if the name ever changes, we can just update the constant as well.
 46: 	 */

 51: 	@Embedded

 53: 	/**

 55: 	 * because they are the easiest way to embed multiple MoneyAmount value objects into the PolicyAggregateRoot.

17: import com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.interfaces.dtos.customer.CustomersDto;
18: import com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.interfaces.dtos.customer.PaginatedCustomerResponseDto;
19: /**
20:  * CustomerCoreRemoteProxy is a remote proxy that interacts with the Customer Core in order to give
21:  * the Policy Management Backend's own clients access to the shared customer data.
22:  * */
23: @Component
24: public class CustomerCoreRemoteProxy implements InfrastructureService {
25: 	@Value("${customercore.baseURL}")
26: 	private String customerCoreBaseURL;
27: 	private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
28: 	@Autowired
29: 	private RestTemplate restTemplate;
30: 	public CustomerDto getCustomer(CustomerId customerId) {
31: 		List<CustomerDto> customers = getCustomersById(customerId);
32: 		return customers.isEmpty() ? null : customers.get(0);
33: 	}
34: 	public PaginatedCustomerResponseDto getCustomers(String filter, int limit, int offset) {
35: 		try {
36: 			UriComponentsBuilder builder = UriComponentsBuilder.fromHttpUrl(customerCoreBaseURL + "/customers")
37: 					.queryParam("filter", filter)
38: 					.queryParam("limit", limit)
39: 					.queryParam("offset", offset);
40: 			return restTemplate.getForObject(builder.toUriString(), PaginatedCustomerResponseDto.class);
41: 		} catch(RestClientException e) {
42: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to connect to Customer Core.";
43: 			logger.warn(errorMessage, e);
44: 			throw new CustomerCoreNotAvailableException(errorMessage);
45: 		}
46: 	}
47: 	public List<CustomerDto> getCustomersById(CustomerId... customerIds) {
48: 		try {
49: 			List<String> customerIdStrings = Arrays.asList(customerIds).stream().map(id -> id.getId()).collect(Collectors.toList());
50: 			String ids = String.join(",", customerIdStrings);
51: 			return restTemplate.getForObject(customerCoreBaseURL + "/customers/" + ids, CustomersDto.class).getCustomers();
52: 		} catch(RestClientException e) {
53: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to connect to Customer Core.";
54: 			logger.warn(errorMessage, e);
55: 			throw new CustomerCoreNotAvailableException(errorMessage);
56: 		}
57: 	}
58: }

12: @Component

14: 	@Value("${apikey.header}")

 6: import javax.servlet.ServletException;
 7: import javax.servlet.ServletRequest;

 9: import org.slf4j.MDC;
10: import org.springframework.core.annotation.Order;
11: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
12: /**
13:  * This RequestTracingFilter class generates a new random ID for each request and stores
14:  * it in the MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context). The ID will then appear in each log entry
15:  * that is logged as a result of the corresponding request. This can help correlate different
16:  * log entries during debugging.
17:  * */
18: @Component
19: @Order(1)
20: public class RequestTracingFilter implements Filter {
21: 	private final static String REQUEST_ID_KEY = "requestId";
22: 	private final Random rand = new Random();
23: 	private String createRequestId() {
24: 		return Integer.toString(rand.nextInt(9999));
25: 	}
26: 	@Override
27: 	public void doFilter(ServletRequest request, ServletResponse response, FilterChain chain) throws IOException, ServletException {
28: 		MDC.put(REQUEST_ID_KEY, createRequestId());
29: 		chain.doFilter(request, response);
30: 	}
31: }

 8: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
 9: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
10: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
11: import org.springframework.jms.config.DefaultJmsListenerContainerFactory;

13: import org.springframework.jms.support.converter.MappingJackson2MessageConverter;
14: import org.springframework.jms.support.converter.MessageConverter;
15: import org.springframework.jms.support.converter.MessageType;
16: import com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.domain.insurancequoterequest.CustomerDecisionEvent;
17: import com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.domain.insurancequoterequest.InsuranceQuoteRequestEvent;
18: /**
19:  * The MessagingConfiguration class configures the ActiveMQ message broker. This broker is used
20:  * to send events to the Risk Management Server when a policy changes.
21:  * */
22: @Configuration
23: public class MessagingConfiguration {
24: 	@Value("${policymanagement.stompBrokerBindAddress}")
25: 	private String stompBrokerBindAddress;
26: 	@Value("${policymanagement.tcpBrokerBindAddress}")
27: 	private String tcpBrokerBindAddress;
28: 	@Value("${spring.activemq.user}")
29: 	private String username;
30: 	@Value("${spring.activemq.password}")
31: 	private String password;
32: 	@Bean
33: 	public BrokerService broker() throws Exception {
34: 		final BrokerService broker = new BrokerService();
35: 		broker.addConnector(stompBrokerBindAddress);
36: 		broker.addConnector(tcpBrokerBindAddress);
37: 		broker.setPersistent(true);
38: 		broker.setUseJmx(true);
39: 		final Map<String, String> userPasswords = new HashMap<>();
40: 		userPasswords.put(username, password);
41: 		SimpleAuthenticationPlugin authenticationPlugin = new SimpleAuthenticationPlugin();
42: 		authenticationPlugin.setUserPasswords(userPasswords);
43: 		broker.setPlugins(new BrokerPlugin[] { authenticationPlugin });
44: 		return broker;
45: 	}
46: 	/**
47: 	 * The @Bean attribute turns the returned object (in this case a MessageConverter) into a Spring bean.
48: 	 * A bean is an object that is instantiated, assembled, and otherwise managed by a Spring container.
49: 	 * Other classes can use dependency injection (e.g., using the @Autowired annotation) to obtain a reference
50: 	 * to a specific bean.
51: 	 *
52: 	 * @see <a href=
53: 	 *      "https://docs.spring.io/spring-javaconfig/docs/1.0.0.M4/reference/html/ch02s02.html">https://docs.spring.io/spring-javaconfig/docs/1.0.0.M4/reference/html/ch02s02.html</a>
54: 	 */
55: 	@Bean
56: 	public MessageConverter jacksonJmsMessageConverter() {
57: 		MappingJackson2MessageConverter converter = new MappingJackson2MessageConverter();
58: 		converter.setTargetType(MessageType.TEXT);
59: 		converter.setTypeIdPropertyName("_type");
60: 		final Map<String, Class<?>> typeIdMappings = new HashMap<>();
61: 		typeIdMappings.put("com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.domain.insurancequoterequest.InsuranceQuoteRequestEvent", InsuranceQuoteRequestEvent.class);
62: 		typeIdMappings.put("com.lakesidemutual.customerselfservice.domain.insurancequoterequest.CustomerDecisionEvent", CustomerDecisionEvent.class);
63: 		converter.setTypeIdMappings(typeIdMappings);
64: 		return converter;
65: 	}
66: 	@Bean
67: 	public ActiveMQConnectionFactory connectionFactory(){
68: 		ActiveMQConnectionFactory connectionFactory = new ActiveMQConnectionFactory();
69: 		connectionFactory.setTrustAllPackages(true);
70: 		connectionFactory.setUserName(username);
71: 		connectionFactory.setPassword(password);
72: 		return connectionFactory;
73: 	}
74: 	@Bean
75: 	public DefaultJmsListenerContainerFactory jmsListenerContainerFactory() {
76: 		DefaultJmsListenerContainerFactory factory = new DefaultJmsListenerContainerFactory();
77: 		factory.setConnectionFactory(connectionFactory());
78: 		factory.setConcurrency("1-1");
79: 		factory.setMessageConverter(jacksonJmsMessageConverter());
80: 		return factory;
81: 	}
82: 	@Bean
83: 	public JmsTemplate jmsTemplate(){
84: 		JmsTemplate template = new JmsTemplate();
85: 		template.setMessageConverter(jacksonJmsMessageConverter());
86: 		template.setConnectionFactory(connectionFactory());
87: 		return template;
88: 	}
89: }

33: 		configuration.setAllowedHeaders(Arrays.asList("authorization", "content-type", "x-auth-token"));
34: 		configuration.setExposedHeaders(Arrays.asList("x-auth-token"));
