 34: /**
 35:  * CustomerDecisionMessageConsumer is a Spring component that consumes CustomerDecisionEvents
 36:  * as they arrive through the ActiveMQ message queue. It processes these events by updating the
 37:  * corresponding insurance quote requests.
 38:  * */
 39: @Component
 40: public class CustomerDecisionMessageConsumer {
 41: 	private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
 42: 	@Autowired
 43: 	private InsuranceQuoteRequestRepository insuranceQuoteRequestRepository;
 44: 	@Autowired
 45: 	private PolicyRepository policyRepository;
 46: 	@Autowired
 47: 	private CustomerSelfServiceMessageProducer customerSelfServiceMessageProducer;
 48: 	@Autowired
 49: 	private RiskManagementMessageProducer riskManagementMessageProducer;
 50: 	@Autowired
 51: 	private CustomerCoreRemoteProxy customerCoreRemoteProxy;
 52: 	@JmsListener(destination = "${customerDecisionEvent.queueName}")
 53: 	public void receiveCustomerDecision(final Message<CustomerDecisionEvent> message) {
 54: 		logger.debug("A new CustomerDecisionEvent has been received.");
 55: 		final CustomerDecisionEvent customerDecisionEvent = message.getPayload();
 56: 		final Long id = customerDecisionEvent.getInsuranceQuoteRequestId();
 57: 		final Optional<InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot> insuranceQuoteRequestOpt = insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.findById(id);
 58: 		if(!insuranceQuoteRequestOpt.isPresent()) {
 59: 			logger.error("Unable to process a customer decision event with an invalid insurance quote request id.");
 60: 			return;
 61: 		}
 62: 		final InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot insuranceQuoteRequest = insuranceQuoteRequestOpt.get();
 63: 		final Date decisionDate = customerDecisionEvent.getDate();
 64: 		if(customerDecisionEvent.isQuoteAccepted()) {
 65: 			if(insuranceQuoteRequest.getStatus().equals(RequestStatus.QUOTE_EXPIRED) || insuranceQuoteRequest.hasQuoteExpired(decisionDate)) {
 66: 				/*
 67: 				 * If the quote has been accepted after it has already expired, we mark the quote as accepted
 68: 				 * and expired and send a InsuranceQuoteExpiredEvent back to the Customer Self-Service backend.
 69: 				 * */
 70: 				Date expirationDate;
 71: 				if(insuranceQuoteRequest.getStatus().equals(RequestStatus.QUOTE_EXPIRED)) {
 72: 					expirationDate = insuranceQuoteRequest.popStatus().getDate();
 73: 				} else {
 74: 					expirationDate = decisionDate;
 75: 				}
 76: 				insuranceQuoteRequest.acceptQuote(decisionDate);
 77: 				insuranceQuoteRequest.markQuoteAsExpired(expirationDate);
 78: 				InsuranceQuoteExpiredEvent event = new InsuranceQuoteExpiredEvent(expirationDate, insuranceQuoteRequest.getId());
 79: 				customerSelfServiceMessageProducer.sendInsuranceQuoteExpiredEvent(event);
 80: 			} else {
 81: 				logger.info("The insurance quote for request {} has been accepted", insuranceQuoteRequest.getId());
 82: 				insuranceQuoteRequest.acceptQuote(decisionDate);
 83: 				PolicyAggregateRoot policy = createPolicyForInsuranceQuoteRequest(insuranceQuoteRequest);
 84: 				String policyId = policy.getId().getId();
 85: 				policyRepository.save(policy);
 86: 				Date policyCreationDate = new Date();
 87: 				insuranceQuoteRequest.finalizeQuote(policyId, policyCreationDate);
 88: 				PolicyCreatedEvent policyCreatedEvent = new PolicyCreatedEvent(policyCreationDate, insuranceQuoteRequest.getId(), policyId);
 89: 				customerSelfServiceMessageProducer.sendPolicyCreatedEvent(policyCreatedEvent);
 90: 				CustomerInfoEntity customerInfo = insuranceQuoteRequest.getCustomerInfo();
 91: 				List<CustomerDto> customers = customerCoreRemoteProxy.getCustomersById(customerInfo.getCustomerId());
 92: 				if(!customers.isEmpty()) {
 93: 					CustomerDto customer = customers.get(0);
 94: 					final PolicyDto policyDto = PolicyDto.fromDomainObject(policy);
 95: 					final UpdatePolicyEvent event = new UpdatePolicyEvent("<customer-self-service-backend>", decisionDate, customer, policyDto);
 96: 					riskManagementMessageProducer.emitEvent(event);
 97: 				}
 98: 			}
 99: 		} else {
100: 			/*
101: 			 * If a quote has been rejected by the customer after it has already expired,
102: 			 * we discard the QUOTE_EXPIRED status in favor of the QUOTE_REJECTED status.
103: 			 * */
104: 			if(insuranceQuoteRequest.getStatus().equals(RequestStatus.QUOTE_EXPIRED)) {
105: 				insuranceQuoteRequest.popStatus();
106: 			}
107: 			logger.info("The insurance quote for request {} has been rejected", insuranceQuoteRequest.getId());
108: 			insuranceQuoteRequest.rejectQuote(decisionDate);
109: 		}
110: 		insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.save(insuranceQuoteRequest);
111: 	}
112: 	private PolicyAggregateRoot createPolicyForInsuranceQuoteRequest(InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot insuranceQuoteRequest) {
113: 		PolicyId policyId = PolicyId.random();
114: 		CustomerId customerId = insuranceQuoteRequest.getCustomerInfo().getCustomerId();
115: 		Date startDate = insuranceQuoteRequest.getInsuranceOptions().getStartDate();
116: 		Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
117: 		calendar.setTime(startDate);
118: 		calendar.add(Calendar.YEAR, 1);
119: 		Date endDate = calendar.getTime();
120: 		PolicyPeriod policyPeriod = new PolicyPeriod(startDate, endDate);
121: 		PolicyType policyType = new PolicyType(insuranceQuoteRequest.getInsuranceOptions().getInsuranceType().getName());
122: 		MoneyAmount deductible = insuranceQuoteRequest.getInsuranceOptions().getDeductible();
123: 		MoneyAmount insurancePremium = insuranceQuoteRequest.getInsuranceQuote().getInsurancePremium();
124: 		MoneyAmount policyLimit = insuranceQuoteRequest.getInsuranceQuote().getPolicyLimit();
125: 		InsuringAgreementEntity insuringAgreement = new InsuringAgreementEntity(Collections.emptyList());
126: 		return new PolicyAggregateRoot(policyId, customerId, new Date(), policyPeriod, policyType, deductible, policyLimit, insurancePremium, insuringAgreement);
127: 	}
128: }

  1: package com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.interfaces;
  2: import static org.springframework.hateoas.server.mvc.WebMvcLinkBuilder.linkTo;
  3: import static org.springframework.hateoas.server.mvc.WebMvcLinkBuilder.methodOn;
  4: import java.util.List;
  5: import java.util.stream.Collectors;
  6: import org.slf4j.Logger;
  7: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
  8: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
  9: import org.springframework.hateoas.Link;
 10: import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
 11: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
 12: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
 13: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
 14: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
 15: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
 16: import com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.domain.customer.CustomerId;
 17: import com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.domain.policy.PolicyAggregateRoot;

 22: import com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.interfaces.dtos.customer.CustomerNotFoundException;
 23: import com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.interfaces.dtos.customer.PaginatedCustomerResponseDto;
 24: import com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.interfaces.dtos.policy.PolicyDto;
 25: import io.swagger.annotations.ApiOperation;
 26: import io.swagger.annotations.ApiParam;
 27: /**
 28:  * This REST controller gives clients access to the customer data. It is an example of the
 29:  * <i>Information Holder Resource</i> pattern. This particular one is a special type of information holder called <i>Master Data Holder</i>.
 30:  *
 31:  * @see <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/responsibility/endpointRoles/InformationHolderResource">Information Holder Resource</a>
 32:  * @see <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/responsibility/informationHolderEndpointTypes/MasterDataHolder">Master Data Holder</a>
 33:  */
 34: @RestController
 35: @RequestMapping("/customers")
 36: public class CustomerInformationHolder {
 37: 	private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
 38: 	@Autowired
 39: 	private PolicyRepository policyRepository;
 40: 	@Autowired
 41: 	private CustomerCoreRemoteProxy customerCoreRemoteProxy;
 42: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Get all customers.")
 43: 	@GetMapping
 44: 	public ResponseEntity<PaginatedCustomerResponseDto> getCustomers(
 45: 			@ApiParam(value = "search terms to filter the customers by name", required = false) @RequestParam(value = "filter", required = false, defaultValue = "") String filter,
 46: 			@ApiParam(value = "the maximum number of customers per page", required = false) @RequestParam(value = "limit", required = false, defaultValue = "10") Integer limit,
 47: 			@ApiParam(value = "the offset of the page's first customer", required = false) @RequestParam(value = "offset", required = false, defaultValue = "0") Integer offset) {
 48: 		logger.debug("Fetching a page of customers (offset={},limit={},filter='{}')", offset, limit, filter);
 49: 		PaginatedCustomerResponseDto paginatedResponseIn = customerCoreRemoteProxy.getCustomers(filter, limit, offset);
 50: 		PaginatedCustomerResponseDto paginatedResponseOut = createPaginatedCustomerResponseDto(
 51: 				paginatedResponseIn.getFilter(),
 52: 				paginatedResponseIn.getLimit(),
 53: 				paginatedResponseIn.getOffset(),
 54: 				paginatedResponseIn.getSize(),
 55: 				paginatedResponseIn.getCustomers());
 56: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(paginatedResponseOut);
 57: 	}
 58: 	private PaginatedCustomerResponseDto createPaginatedCustomerResponseDto(String filter, Integer limit, Integer offset, int size, List<CustomerDto> customerDtos) {
 59: 		customerDtos.forEach(this::addCustomerLinks);
 60: 		PaginatedCustomerResponseDto paginatedCustomerResponseDto = new PaginatedCustomerResponseDto(filter, limit, offset, size, customerDtos);
 61: 		paginatedCustomerResponseDto.add(linkTo(methodOn(CustomerInformationHolder.class).getCustomers(filter, limit, offset)).withSelfRel());
 62: 		if (offset > 0) {
 63: 			paginatedCustomerResponseDto.add(linkTo(
 64: 					methodOn(CustomerInformationHolder.class).getCustomers(filter, limit, Math.max(0, offset - limit)))
 65: 					.withRel("prev"));
 66: 		}
 67: 		if (offset < size - limit) {
 68: 			paginatedCustomerResponseDto.add(linkTo(methodOn(CustomerInformationHolder.class).getCustomers(filter, limit, offset + limit))
 69: 					.withRel("next"));
 70: 		}
 71: 		return paginatedCustomerResponseDto;
 72: 	}
 73: 	/**
 74: 	 * The CustomerDto could contain a nested list containing the customer's policies. However, many clients may not be
 75: 	 * interested in the policies when they access the customer resource. To avoid sending large messages containing lots
 76: 	 * of data that is not or seldom needed we instead add a link to a separate endpoint which returns the customer's policies.
 77: 	 * This is an example of the <i>Linked Information Holder</i> pattern.
 78: 	 *
 79: 	 * @see <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/referenceManagement/LinkedInformationHolder">Linked Information Holder</a>
 80: 	 */
 81: 	private void addCustomerLinks(CustomerDto customerDto) {
 82: 		CustomerIdDto customerId = new CustomerIdDto(customerDto.getCustomerId());
 83: 		Link selfLink = linkTo(methodOn(CustomerInformationHolder.class).getCustomer(customerId)).withSelfRel();
 84: 		Link policiesLink = linkTo(methodOn(CustomerInformationHolder.class).getPolicies(customerId, "")).withRel("policies");
 85: 		customerDto.add(selfLink);
 86: 		customerDto.add(policiesLink);
 87: 	}
 88: 	/**
 89: 	 * Returns the customer with the given customer id. Example Usage:
 90: 	 *
 91: 	 * <pre>
 92: 	 * <code>
 93: 	 * GET http://localhost:8090/customers/rgpp0wkpec
 94: 	 *
 95: 	 * {
 96: 	 *   "customerId" : "rgpp0wkpec",
 97: 	 *   "firstname" : "Max",
 98: 	 *   "lastname" : "Mustermann",
 99: 	 *   "birthday" : "1989-12-31T23:00:00.000+0000",
100: 	 *   "streetAddress" : "Oberseestrasse 10",
101: 	 *   "postalCode" : "8640",
102: 	 *   "city" : "Rapperswil",
103: 	 *   "email" : "admin@example.com",
104: 	 *   "phoneNumber" : "055 222 4111",
105: 	 *   "moveHistory" : [ ]
106: 	 * }
107: 	 * </code>
108: 	 * </pre>
109: 	 * If the given customer id is not valid, an error response with HTTP Status Code 404 is returned. The response body contains additional
110: 	 * information about the error in JSON form. This is an example of the <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/qualityManagementAndGovernance/ErrorReport">Error Report</a>
111: 	 * pattern:
112: 	 * <pre>
113: 	 * <code>
114: 	 * GET http://localhost:8090/customers/123
115: 	 *
116: 	 * {
117: 	 *   "timestamp" : "2018-09-18T08:28:44.644+0000",
118: 	 *   "status" : 404,
119: 	 *   "error" : "Not Found",
120: 	 *   "message" : "Failed to find a customer with id '123'.",
121: 	 *   "path" : "/customers/123"
122: 	 * }
123: 	 * </code>
124: 	 * </pre>
125: 	 *
126: 	 * @see <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/qualityManagementAndGovernance/ErrorReport">https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/qualityManagementAndGovernance/ErrorReport</a>
127: 	 */
128: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Get customer with a given customer id.")
129: 	@GetMapping(value = "/{customerIdDto}")
130: 	public ResponseEntity<CustomerDto> getCustomer(
131: 			@ApiParam(value = "the customer's unique id", required = true) @PathVariable CustomerIdDto customerIdDto) {
132: 		CustomerId customerId = new CustomerId(customerIdDto.getId());
133: 		logger.debug("Fetching a customer with id '{}'", customerId.getId());
134: 		CustomerDto customer = customerCoreRemoteProxy.getCustomer(customerId);
135: 		if(customer == null) {
136: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to find a customer with id '{}'";
137: 			logger.warn(errorMessage, customerId.getId());
138: 			throw new CustomerNotFoundException(errorMessage);
139: 		}
140: 		addCustomerLinks(customer);
141: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(customer);
142: 	}
143: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Get a customer's policies.")
144: 	@GetMapping(value = "/{customerIdDto}/policies")
145: 	public ResponseEntity<List<PolicyDto>> getPolicies(
146: 			@ApiParam(value = "the customer's unique id", required = true) @PathVariable CustomerIdDto customerIdDto,
147: 			@ApiParam(value = "a comma-separated list of the fields that should be expanded in the response", required = false) @RequestParam(value = "expand", required = false, defaultValue = "") String expand) {
148: 		CustomerId customerId = new CustomerId(customerIdDto.getId());
149: 		logger.debug("Fetching policies for customer with id '{}' (fields='{}')", customerId.getId(), expand);
150: 		List<PolicyAggregateRoot> policies = policyRepository.findAllByCustomerIdOrderByCreationDateDesc(customerId);
151: 		List<PolicyDto> policyDtos = policies.stream().map(p -> createPolicyDto(p, expand)).collect(Collectors.toList());
152: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(policyDtos);
153: 	}
154: 	private PolicyDto createPolicyDto(PolicyAggregateRoot policy, String expand) {
155: 		PolicyDto policyDto = PolicyDto.fromDomainObject(policy);
156: 		if(expand.equals("customer")) {
157: 			CustomerDto customer = customerCoreRemoteProxy.getCustomer(policy.getCustomerId());
158: 			policyDto.setCustomer(customer);
159: 		}
160: 		Link selfLink = linkTo(methodOn(PolicyInformationHolder.class).getPolicy(policy.getId(), expand)).withSelfRel();
161: 		policyDto.add(selfLink);
162: 		return policyDto;
163: 	}
164: }

 3: import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonUnwrapped;
 4: /**
 5:  * The CustomerDto class is a data transfer object (DTO) that represents a single customer.
 6:  * It inherits from the ResourceSupport class which allows us to create a REST representation (e.g., JSON, XML)
 7:  * that follows the HATEOAS principle. For example, links can be added to the representation (e.g., self, address.change)
 8:  * which means that future actions the client may take can be discovered from the resource representation.
 9:  *
10:  * The CustomerDto is part of the API contract (see the getCustomer() method in @CustomerInformationHolder). In the Swagger API docs
11:  * (http://localhost:8090/v2/api-docs) generated by SpringFox the is represented by the following JSON Schema. JSON Schema (https://json-schema.org/)
12:  * is an IETF draft to define the schema of JSON documents:
13:  *
14:  * <pre>
15:  * <code>
16:  * {
17:  *  "title":"CustomerDto",
18:  *  "type":"object",
19:  *  "properties":{
20:  *     // Note that this _links section of the JSON Schema appears here, because CustomerDto
21:  *     // inherits from ResourceSupport which can add HATEOAS links to the JSON representation
22:  *     // of the resource.
23:  *     "_links":{
24:  *        "type":"array",
25:  *        "xml":{
26:  *           "name":"link",
27:  *           "attribute":false,
28:  *           "wrapped":false
29:  *        },

 1: package com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.interfaces;
 2: import java.util.Map;
 3: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
 4: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 5: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 6: import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.web.servlet.error.AbstractErrorController;
 7: import org.springframework.boot.web.error.ErrorAttributeOptions;
 8: import org.springframework.boot.web.servlet.error.ErrorAttributes;
 9: import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
10: import org.springframework.stereotype.Controller;
11: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
12: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ResponseBody;
13: /**
14:  * This class implements a custom error controller that returns an <a href=
15:  * "https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/qualityManagementAndGovernance/ErrorReport">Error
16:  * Report</a>.
17:  */
18: @Controller
19: public class ErrorController extends AbstractErrorController {
20: 	private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
21: 	public ErrorController(ErrorAttributes errorAttributes) {
22: 		super(errorAttributes);
23: 	}
24: 	@RequestMapping(value = "/error", produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
25: 	@ResponseBody
26: 	public Map<String, Object> handleError(HttpServletRequest request) {
27: 		Map<String, Object> errorAttributes = super.getErrorAttributes(request, ErrorAttributeOptions.of(ErrorAttributeOptions.Include.STACK_TRACE));
28: 		Object path = errorAttributes.get("path");
29: 		Object status = errorAttributes.get("status");
30: 		Object error = errorAttributes.get("error");
31: 		Object message = errorAttributes.get("message");
32: 		logger.warn("An error occurred while accessing {}: {} {}, {}", path, status, error, message);
33: 		return errorAttributes;
34: 	}
35: 	@Override
36: 	public String getErrorPath() {
37: 		return "/error";
38: 	}
39: }

 30: /**
 31:  * This REST controller gives clients access to the insurance quote requests. It is an example of the
 32:  * <i>Information Holder Resource</i> pattern. This particular one is a special type of information holder called <i>Operational Data Holder</i>.
 33:  *
 34:  * @see <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/responsibility/informationHolderEndpointTypes/OperationalDataHolder">Operational Data Holder</a>
 35:  * 
 36:  * As it supports responding to requests, you can also view it as a Processing Resource:
 37:  * 
 38:  *  * @see <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/responsibility/endpointRoles/ProcessingResource">Processing Resource</a>
 39:  *  
 40:  *Matching RDD role stereotypes are <i>Coordinator</i> and <i>Information Holder</i>:
 41:  *
 42:  *  * @see <a href="http://www.wirfs-brock.com/PDFs/A_Brief-Tour-of-RDD.pdf">A Brief Tour of RDD</a>
 43:  */
 44: @RestController
 45: @RequestMapping("/insurance-quote-requests")
 46: public class InsuranceQuoteRequestCoordinator {
 47: 	private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
 48: 	@Autowired
 49: 	private InsuranceQuoteRequestRepository insuranceQuoteRequestRepository;
 50: 	@Autowired
 51: 	private CustomerSelfServiceMessageProducer customerSelfServiceMessageProducer;
 52: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Get all Insurance Quote Requests.")
 53: 	@GetMapping
 54: 	public ResponseEntity<List<InsuranceQuoteRequestDto>> getInsuranceQuoteRequests() {
 55: 		logger.debug("Fetching all Insurance Quote Requests");
 56: 		List<InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot> quoteRequests = insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.findAllByOrderByDateDesc();
 57: 		List<InsuranceQuoteRequestDto> quoteRequestDtos = quoteRequests.stream().map(InsuranceQuoteRequestDto::fromDomainObject).collect(Collectors.toList());
 58: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(quoteRequestDtos);
 59: 	}
 60: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Get a specific Insurance Quote Request.")
 61: 	@GetMapping(value = "/{id}") /* MAP: Retrieval Operation */
 62: 	public ResponseEntity<InsuranceQuoteRequestDto> getInsuranceQuoteRequest(@ApiParam(value = "the insurance quote request's unique id", required = true) @PathVariable Long id) {
 63: 		logger.debug("Fetching Insurance Quote Request with id '{}'", id);
 64: 		Optional<InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot> optInsuranceQuoteRequest = insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.findById(id);
 65: 		if (!optInsuranceQuoteRequest.isPresent()) {
 66: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to find an Insurance Quote Request with id '{}'";
 67: 			logger.warn(errorMessage, id);
 68: 			throw new InsuranceQuoteRequestNotFoundException(errorMessage);
 69: 		}
 70: 		InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot insuranceQuoteRequest = optInsuranceQuoteRequest.get();
 71: 		InsuranceQuoteRequestDto insuranceQuoteRequestDto = InsuranceQuoteRequestDto.fromDomainObject(insuranceQuoteRequest);
 72: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(insuranceQuoteRequestDto);
 73: 	}
 74: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Updates the status of an existing Insurance Quote Request")
 75: 	@PatchMapping(value = "/{id}") /* MAP: State Transition Operation */
 76: 	public ResponseEntity<InsuranceQuoteRequestDto> respondToInsuranceQuoteRequest(
 77: 			@ApiParam(value = "the insurance quote request's unique id", required = true) @PathVariable Long id,
 78: 			@ApiParam(value = "the response that contains a new insurance quote if the request has been accepted", required = true)
 79: 			@Valid @RequestBody InsuranceQuoteResponseDto insuranceQuoteResponseDto) {
 80: 		logger.debug("Responding to Insurance Quote Request with id '{}'", id);
 81: 		Optional<InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot> optInsuranceQuoteRequest = insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.findById(id);
 82: 		if (!optInsuranceQuoteRequest.isPresent()) {
 83: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to respond to Insurance Quote Request, because there is no Insurance Quote Request with id '{}'";
 84: 			logger.warn(errorMessage, id);
 85: 			throw new InsuranceQuoteRequestNotFoundException(errorMessage);
 86: 		}
 87: 		final Date date = new Date();
 88: 		final InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot insuranceQuoteRequest = optInsuranceQuoteRequest.get();
 89: 		if(insuranceQuoteResponseDto.getStatus().equals(RequestStatus.QUOTE_RECEIVED.toString())) {
 90: 			logger.info("Insurance Quote Request with id '{}' has been accepted", id);
 91: 			Date expirationDate = insuranceQuoteResponseDto.getExpirationDate();
 92: 			MoneyAmountDto insurancePremiumDto = insuranceQuoteResponseDto.getInsurancePremium();
 93: 			MoneyAmountDto policyLimitDto = insuranceQuoteResponseDto.getPolicyLimit();
 94: 			MoneyAmount insurancePremium = insurancePremiumDto.toDomainObject();
 95: 			MoneyAmount policyLimit = policyLimitDto.toDomainObject();
 96: 			InsuranceQuoteEntity insuranceQuote = new InsuranceQuoteEntity(expirationDate, insurancePremium, policyLimit);
 97: 			insuranceQuoteRequest.acceptRequest(insuranceQuote, date);
 98: 			final InsuranceQuoteResponseEvent insuranceQuoteResponseEvent = new InsuranceQuoteResponseEvent(date, insuranceQuoteRequest.getId(), true, expirationDate, insurancePremiumDto, policyLimitDto);
 99: 			customerSelfServiceMessageProducer.sendInsuranceQuoteResponseEvent(insuranceQuoteResponseEvent);
100: 		} else if(insuranceQuoteResponseDto.getStatus().equals(RequestStatus.REQUEST_REJECTED.toString())) {
101: 			logger.info("Insurance Quote Request with id '{}' has been rejected", id);
102: 			insuranceQuoteRequest.rejectRequest(date);
103: 			final InsuranceQuoteResponseEvent insuranceQuoteResponseEvent = new InsuranceQuoteResponseEvent(date, insuranceQuoteRequest.getId(), false, null, null, null);
104: 			customerSelfServiceMessageProducer.sendInsuranceQuoteResponseEvent(insuranceQuoteResponseEvent);
105: 		}
106: 		insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.save(insuranceQuoteRequest);
107: 		InsuranceQuoteRequestDto insuranceQuoteRequestDto = InsuranceQuoteRequestDto.fromDomainObject(insuranceQuoteRequest);
108: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(insuranceQuoteRequestDto);
109: 	}
110: }

18: /**
19:  * InsuranceQuoteRequestMessageConsumer is a Spring component that consumes InsuranceQuoteRequestEvents
20:  * as they arrive through the ActiveMQ message queue. It processes these events by creating corresponding
21:  * InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot instances.
22:  * */

24: public class InsuranceQuoteRequestMessageConsumer {
25: 	private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
26: 	@Autowired
27: 	private InsuranceQuoteRequestRepository insuranceQuoteRequestRepository;
28: 	@JmsListener(destination = "${insuranceQuoteRequestEvent.queueName}")
29: 	public void receiveInsuranceQuoteRequest(final Message<InsuranceQuoteRequestEvent> message) {
30: 		logger.info("A new InsuranceQuoteRequestEvent has been received.");
31: 		InsuranceQuoteRequestEvent insuranceQuoteRequestEvent = message.getPayload();
32: 		InsuranceQuoteRequestDto insuranceQuoteRequestDto = insuranceQuoteRequestEvent.getInsuranceQuoteRequestDto();
33: 		Long id = insuranceQuoteRequestDto.getId();
34: 		Date date = insuranceQuoteRequestDto.getDate();
35: 		List<RequestStatusChangeDto> statusHistory = insuranceQuoteRequestDto.getStatusHistory();
36: 		RequestStatus status = RequestStatus.valueOf(statusHistory.get(statusHistory.size()-1).getStatus());
37: 		CustomerInfoEntity customerInfo = insuranceQuoteRequestDto.getCustomerInfo().toDomainObject();
38: 		InsuranceOptionsEntity insuranceOptions = insuranceQuoteRequestDto.getInsuranceOptions().toDomainObject();
39: 		InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot insuranceQuoteAggregateRoot = new InsuranceQuoteRequestAggregateRoot(id, date, status, customerInfo, insuranceOptions, null, null);
40: 		insuranceQuoteRequestRepository.save(insuranceQuoteAggregateRoot);
41: 	}
42: }

147: 	private List<PolicyDto> createPolicyDtos(List<PolicyAggregateRoot> policies, String expand) {
148: 		List<CustomerDto> customers = null;
149: 		if(expand.equals("customer")) {
150: 			List<CustomerId> customerIds = policies.stream().map(p -> p.getCustomerId()).collect(Collectors.toList());
151: 			customers = customerCoreRemoteProxy.getCustomersById(customerIds.toArray(new CustomerId[customerIds.size()]));
152: 		}
153: 		List<PolicyDto> policyDtos = new ArrayList<>();
154: 		for(int i = 0; i < policies.size(); i++) {
155: 			PolicyAggregateRoot policy = policies.get(i);
156: 			PolicyDto policyDto = PolicyDto.fromDomainObject(policy);
157: 			if(customers != null) {
158: 				CustomerDto customer = customers.get(i);
159: 				policyDto.setCustomer(customer);
160: 			}
161: 			policyDtos.add(policyDto);
162: 		}
163: 		return policyDtos;
164: 	}
165: 	private PaginatedPolicyResponseDto createPaginatedPolicyResponseDto(Integer limit, Integer offset, String expand, int size,
166: 			List<PolicyDto> policyDtos) {
167: 		PaginatedPolicyResponseDto paginatedPolicyResponseDto = new PaginatedPolicyResponseDto(limit, offset,
168: 				size, policyDtos);
169: 		paginatedPolicyResponseDto.add(linkTo(methodOn(PolicyInformationHolder.class).getPolicies(limit, offset, expand)).withSelfRel());
170: 		if (offset > 0) {
171: 			paginatedPolicyResponseDto.add(linkTo(
172: 					methodOn(PolicyInformationHolder.class).getPolicies(limit, Math.max(0, offset - limit), expand))
173: 					.withRel("prev"));
174: 		}
175: 		if (offset < size - limit) {
176: 			paginatedPolicyResponseDto.add(linkTo(methodOn(PolicyInformationHolder.class).getPolicies(limit, offset + limit, expand))
177: 					.withRel("next"));
178: 		}
179: 		return paginatedPolicyResponseDto;
180: 	}

185: 			@ApiParam(value = "the offset of the page's first policy", required = false) @RequestParam(value = "offset", required = false, defaultValue = "0") Integer offset,

198: 	 * By default, getPolicy() returns the following response:

208: 	 *   ...
209: 	 * }
210: 	 *   </code>
211: 	 * </pre>
212: 	 *
213: 	 * The response includes only the customer's id. The {@code _expandable } section indicates that the {@code customer } resource can be expanded:
214: 	 *
215: 	 * <pre>
216: 	 *   <code>
217: 	 * GET http://localhost:8090/policies/h3riovf4xq/?expand=customer
218: 	 *
219: 	 * {
220: 	 *   "_expandable" : [ "customer" ],
221: 	 *   "policyId" : "h3riovf4xq",
222: 	 *   "customer" : {
223: 	 *     "customerId" : "rgpp0wkpec",
224: 	 *     "customerProfile" : {
225: 	 *       "firstname" : "Max",
226: 	 *       "lastname" : "Mustermann",
227: 	 *       ...
228: 	 *     },
229: 	 *     ...
230: 	 *   },
231: 	 *   "creationDate" : "2018-06-19T12:45:46.743+0000",
232: 	 *   ...
233: 	 * }
234: 	 *   </code>
235: 	 * </pre>
236: 	 *
237: 	 * @see <a href=
238: 	 *      "https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/dataTransferParsimony/WishList">https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/quality/dataTransferParsimony/WishList</a>
239: 	 */
240: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Get a single policy.")
241: 	@GetMapping(value = "/{policyId}")
242: 	public ResponseEntity<PolicyDto> getPolicy(
243: 			@ApiParam(value = "the policy's unique id", required = true) @PathVariable PolicyId policyId,
244: 			@ApiParam(value = "a comma-separated list of the fields that should be expanded in the response", required = false) @RequestParam(value = "expand", required = false, defaultValue = "") String expand) {
245: 		logger.debug("Fetching policy with id '{}'", policyId.getId());
246: 		Optional<PolicyAggregateRoot> optPolicy = policyRepository.findById(policyId);
247: 		if(!optPolicy.isPresent()) {
248: 			final String errorMessage = "Failed to find a policy with id '{}'";
249: 			logger.warn(errorMessage, policyId.getId());
250: 			throw new PolicyNotFoundException(errorMessage);
251: 		}
252: 		PolicyAggregateRoot policy = optPolicy.get();
253: 		PolicyDto response = createPolicyDtos(Arrays.asList(policy), expand).get(0);
254: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
255: 	}
256: }

File: policy-management-backend/src/main/java/com/lakesidemutual/policymanagement/interfaces/RiskComputationService.java
================
 1: package com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.interfaces;
 2: import java.time.LocalDate;
 3: import java.time.Period;
 4: import java.time.ZoneId;
 5: import java.util.Date;
 6: import javax.validation.Valid;
 7: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 8: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 9: import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
10: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
11: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
12: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
13: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
14: import com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.interfaces.dtos.risk.RiskFactorRequestDto;
15: import com.lakesidemutual.policymanagement.interfaces.dtos.risk.RiskFactorResponseDto;
16: import io.swagger.annotations.ApiOperation;
17: import io.swagger.annotations.ApiParam;
18: /**
19:  * This REST controller allows clients to compute the risk factor for a given customer. It is an application of
20:  * the <a href="https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/responsibility/operationResponsibilities/ComputationFunction">Computation Function</a> pattern.
21:  * A Computation Service performs a function f that only depends on its input parameters and does not alter the state of the server.
22:  *
23:  * @see <a href=
24:  *      "https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/responsibility/operationResponsibilities/ComputationFunction">https://www.microservice-api-patterns.org/patterns/responsibility/operationResponsibilities/ComputationFunction</a>
25:  */
26: @RestController
27: @RequestMapping("/riskfactor")
28: public class RiskComputationService {
29: 	private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(this.getClass());
30: 	@ApiOperation(value = "Computes the risk factor for a given customer.")
31: 	@PostMapping(value = "/compute")
32: 	public ResponseEntity<RiskFactorResponseDto> computeRiskFactor(
33: 			@ApiParam(value = "the request containing relevant customer attributes (e.g., postal code, birthday)", required = true)
34: 			@Valid
35: 			@RequestBody
36: 			RiskFactorRequestDto riskFactorRequest) {
37: 		int age = getAge(riskFactorRequest.getBirthday());
38: 		String postalCode = riskFactorRequest.getPostalCode();
39: 		logger.debug("Computing risk factor (age={}, postal-code={})", age, postalCode);
40: 		int riskFactor = computeRiskFactor(age, postalCode);
41: 		return ResponseEntity.ok(new RiskFactorResponseDto(riskFactor));
42: 	}
43: 	private int getAge(Date birthday) {
44: 		LocalDate birthdayLocalDate = birthday.toInstant().atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()).toLocalDate();
45: 		LocalDate now = LocalDate.now();
46: 		return Period.between(birthdayLocalDate, now).getYears();
47: 	}
48: 	private int computeRiskFactor(int age, String postalCode) {
49: 		int ageGroupRiskFactor = computeAgeGroupRiskFactor(age);
50: 		int localityRiskFactor = computeLocalityRiskFactor(postalCode);
51: 		return (ageGroupRiskFactor + localityRiskFactor) / 2;
52: 	}
53: 	private int computeAgeGroupRiskFactor(int age) {
54: 		if(age > 90) {
55: 			return 100;
56: 		} else if(age > 70) {
57: 			return 90;
58: 		} else if(age > 60) {
59: 			return 70;
60: 		} else if(age > 50) {
61: 			return 60;
62: 		} else if(age > 40) {
63: 			return 50;
64: 		} else if(age > 25) {
65: 			return 20;
66: 		} else {
67: 			return 40;
68: 		}
69: 	}
70: 	private int computeLocalityRiskFactor(String postalCodeStr) {
71: 		try {
72: 			int postalCode = Integer.parseInt(postalCodeStr);
73: 			if((postalCode >= 8000 && postalCode < 9000) || (postalCode >= 1000 && postalCode < 2000)) {
74: 				return 80;
75: 			} else if(postalCode >= 5000 && postalCode < 6000) {
76: 				return 10;
77: 			} else {
78: 				return 30;
79: 			}
80: 		} catch(NumberFormatException e) {
81: 			return 0;
82: 		}
83: 	}
84: }

File: risk-management-server/lib/data-manager.js
================
 1: const path = require('path')
 2: const fs = require('fs')
 3: const dataFilePath = path.join(__dirname, '../data/data.json')
 4: const initialDataFilePath = path.join(__dirname, '../data/initial-data.json')
 5: module.exports = class DataManager {
 6:   constructor() {
 7:     const filePath = fs.existsSync(dataFilePath)
 8:       ? dataFilePath
 9:       : initialDataFilePath
10:     const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath)
11:     this.data = JSON.parse(content)
12:   }
13:   addEvent(event) {
14:     if (event.kind === 'UpdatePolicyEvent') {
15:       this.handleUpdatePolicyEvent(event)
16:     } else if (event.kind === 'DeletePolicyEvent') {
17:       this.handleDeletePolicyEvent(event)
18:     }
19:   }
20:   handleUpdatePolicyEvent(event) {
21:     const customerId = event.customer.customerId
22:     const customerData = {
23:       customerProfile: event.customer,
24:       policies: (this.data[customerId] && this.data[customerId].policies) || {},
25:     }
26:     customerData.policies[event.policy.policyId] = event.policy
27:     this.data[customerId] = customerData
28:   }
29:   handleDeletePolicyEvent(event) {
30:     const policyId = event.policyId
31:     const customers = Object.values(this.data)
32:     for (const customer of customers) {
33:       delete customer.policies[policyId]
34:     }
35:   }
36:   async save() {
37:     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
38:       const content = JSON.stringify(this.data)
39:       fs.writeFile(dataFilePath, content, error => {
40:         if (error) {
41:           reject(error)
42:         } else {
43:           resolve()
44:         }
45:       })
46:     })
47:   }
48: }

  9:         label: 'Customer Count',
 10:         value: 'customerCount',
 11:       },
 12:       {
 13:         label: 'Policy Count',
 14:         value: 'policyCount',
 15:       },
 16:       {

 18:         value: 'avgDeductible',

 20:       {

 22:         value: 'avgInsurancePremium',
 23:       },
 24:       {

 26:         value: 'avgPolicyLimit',
 27:       },
 28:     ]
 29:     let customerCount = 0
 30:     let policyCount = 0
 31:     let deductibleTotal = 0
 32:     let insurancePremiumTotal = 0
 33:     let policyLimitTotal = 0
 34:     const customers = Object.values(this.data)
 35:     for (const customer of customers) {
 36:       customerCount += 1
 37:       const policies = Object.values(customer.policies)
 38:       for (const policy of policies) {

 42:         policyLimitTotal += policy.policyLimit.amount
 43:       }

 46:       policyCount > 0 ? (deductibleTotal / policyCount).toFixed() + ' CHF' : '-'
 47:     const avgInsurancePremium =
 48:       policyCount > 0
 49:         ? (insurancePremiumTotal / policyCount).toFixed() + ' CHF'
 50:         : '-'
 51:     const avgPolicyLimit =
 52:       policyCount > 0
 53:         ? (policyLimitTotal / policyCount).toFixed() + ' CHF'
 54:         : '-'

 56:       customerCount,
 57:       policyCount,
 58:       avgDeductible,
 59:       avgInsurancePremium,
 60:       avgPolicyLimit,

 64:   getAgeGroupData() {

 66:     const now = new Date()
 67:     let total = 0
 68:     const ageGroups = [
 69:       {
 70:         ageGroup: '0 - 20',
 71:         cutOff: 20,
 72:         total: 0,
 73:       },
 74:       {
 75:         ageGroup: '20 - 30',
 76:         cutOff: 30,
 77:         total: 0,

 79:       {
 80:         ageGroup: '30 - 40',
 81:         cutOff: 40,
 82:         total: 0,
 83:       },
 84:       {
 85:         ageGroup: '40 - 50',
 86:         cutOff: 50,
 87:         total: 0,
 88:       },
 89:       {
 90:         ageGroup: '50 - 60',
 91:         cutOff: 60,
 92:         total: 0,
 93:       },
 94:       {
 95:         ageGroup: '60 - 80',
 96:         cutOff: 80,
 97:         total: 0,
 98:       },
 99:       {
100:         ageGroup: '> 80',
101:         cutOff: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
102:         total: 0,
103:       },
104:     ]
105:     for (const customer of customers) {
106:       const birthdayDate = new Date(customer.customerProfile.birthday)
107:       const ageInYears = (now - birthdayDate) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 365)
108:       total += 1
109:       for (const ageGroup of ageGroups) {
110:         if (ageInYears < ageGroup.cutOff) {
111:           ageGroup.total += 1

118:       percentage:

120:       total: ageGroup.total,
